Missing Authorization vulnerability in the device and deployment group pages in nerves-hub nerves_hub_web allows an authenticated organization member with the view role to change devices and deployment groups via LiveView events reserved for the manage role. The event handlers that add and delete device certificates, add and remove tags, overwrite or clear a device's manual location, remove a device from its deployment group, move matched devices into a deployment group or remove unmatched ones, import devices from a CSV, and start, retry or delete firmware delta builds carry out the change without calling authorized!/2, and the pages render the controls to every member.

A view member can add a certificate that lets whoever holds its key connect as the device, delete a certificate so the device can no longer authenticate with it, and change which deployment group, and so which firmware release, a device receives. Everything stays within the organizations the member belongs to.

This issue affects nerves_hub: from 1.0.0 before 2.5.3.

Improper Session Invalidation vulnerability in the dashboard pages, device console and local shell channels in nerves-hub nerves_hub_web allows an organization member who is removed or given a lower role to keep acting at their old role through anything they had open at the time. The dashboard reads the member's role once when a page mounts, in the assign_org_to_scope hook of NervesHubWeb.Auth, and the console, local shell and device event stream channels check membership once at join. Removing a member or changing their role tells none of them, so open pages keep carrying out actions and open consoles keep running commands on the device until the page reloads or the socket disconnects.

The dashboard also opens consoles over NervesHubWeb.UserSocket with a token that holds only the user's id, is accepted for 24 hours, and is not revoked by signing out, which disconnects only the session's LiveViews. Whoever holds a token taken from a page can open consoles as that user, within the user's current membership, until it expires.

This issue affects nerves_hub: from 1.0.0 before 2.5.3.

Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes vulnerability in the device API, device forms, signing key and product forms and JITP settings in nerves-hub nerves_hub_web allows an authenticated user who manages devices in any organization to write into other organizations via submitted org_id, product_id and deployment_id fields. The device API create and update actions and the dashboard device forms pass the request parameters to NervesHub.Devices.Device.changeset/2, which casts the organization, product, deployment group and update state as given. The signing key and product forms merge the session's organization into the submitted parameters so that a submitted org_id wins, and the JITP changeset accepts any product_id. Each request requires the manage role only in the user's own organization, and any account can create one.

A device placed on another organization's deployment group, or moved into its product, is sent that organization's firmware with a download URL. The user cannot change or control devices that already belong to the other organization, and cannot upload firmware to it.

This issue affects nerves_hub: from 1.0.0 before 2.5.3.

Improper Authentication vulnerability in Google sign-in and email confirmation in nerves-hub nerves_hub_web allows an attacker who registers another person's email address to share that person's account once they sign in. NervesHub.Accounts.update_or_create_user_from_ueberauth/1 signs a Google user in to any account carrying the same email that is not yet linked to a Google account, links it and marks the email confirmed, without the account's owner ever having proved they own the address. NervesHubWeb.SessionController.confirm/2 likewise signs in whoever follows a confirmation link. An attacker registers the address from the sign-up form, changes their own account's email to it, or registers it as an organization admin from an invite link, and keeps the password; when the address's owner signs in with Google or follows the confirmation link, they land in that account.

The Google path also creates accounts with registrations closed and never checks Google's email_verified claim, and the API's password sign-in in NervesHubWeb.API.UserController issues tokens to accounts whose email was never confirmed. The attacker gains only what the victim is granted afterwards, and nothing on accounts whose owners never use either path.

This issue affects nerves_hub: from 2.3.0 before 2.5.3.

Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in the devices page bulk move in nerves-hub nerves_hub_web allows an authenticated user with the manage role in one organization and only the view role in another to move devices into the second organization's product via the "Move device(s) to product" action. The target-product event in NervesHubWeb.Live.Devices.Index looks the product up with NervesHub.Products.get_by_id/2, which checks that the user is a member of the product's organization at any role, and move-devices-product then changes each selected device's organization and product. The device API's move requires manage in the target organization, and an earlier fix added the check on the organization the devices leave but not on the one they enter.

A moved device keeps its key and certificate, joins the target organization's matching deployment groups, and is sent their firmware with a download URL, which the view role cannot otherwise obtain. The user cannot change or control devices that already belong to the other organization.

This issue affects nerves_hub: from 1.0.0 before 2.5.3.

This issue can cause a heap-use-after-free when an embedder unloads a ReloadableString buffer while a previously returned raw character pointer remains in use. Successful triggering may cause the Escargot-based process to crash, resulting in a denial of service.

Authentication Bypass by Alternate Name vulnerability in Apache Shiro.

This issue affects Apache Shiro: before 2.0.7.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.7, which fixes the issue.

The issue only effects static files. If static files are served from a case-insensitive filesystem,
such as default macOS setup, static files may be accessed by varying the case of the filename in the request.
If only lower-case (common default) filters are present in Shiro, they may be bypassed this way.

Shiro 2.1.0 and later has a new parameters to remediate this issue
shiro.ini: filterChainResolver.caseInsensitive = true
application.properties: shiro.caseInsensitive=true

Shiro 3.0.0 and later makes this the default in shiro.ini-based configurations.
Shiro 3.0.1 and later makes this the default in all configurations, including programmatic and Spring / Spring Boot.
Untrusted users could roll back security updates when using the PackageKit Zypp Backend before 1.4.1, allowing privilege escalation.

A flaw was found in the rrule validation of schedules in automation controller. Several non-anchored regular expressions with lazy wildcard prefixes are applied to the user-supplied rrule value; when the expected DTSTART/RRULE tokens are absent, validation time grows quadratically with the length of the value. An authenticated user can submit a large token-free rrule through the REST API, including the schedule preview endpoint, which requires no resource-level permissions; validation runs synchronously in the API web worker, so a single such request occupies a worker for an extended time and repeated requests can exhaust the web worker pool, denying access to the API and web UI while the attack is sustained. The impact is limited to availability.
A high privileged remote attacker can upload arbitrary files to a guessable location. This can result in a loss of availability and might be chained with other vulnerabilities.
The backups created by the application use a weak static password allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker to access their content. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality.

An unauthenticated remote attacker can perform a XSS attack on a logged in backend user allowing for execution of multiple critical system actions. This could allow an attacker to shutdown the server or restore an uploaded backup. This can result in a loss of integrity and availability.
An unauthenticated remote attacker can perform a DoS in the backends backup creation function. This can result in a total loss of availability.

A high privileged remote attacker can perform a code injection in the backends backup restore function leading to code execution. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability.

A high privileged remote attacker can perform a code injection in the backends network auth function leading to code execution. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability.

A flaw was found in the authentication session handling of the keycloak-services component in Keycloak. The issue occurs because the system fails to verify if an authenticator is valid for the current authentication flow when switching between the standard authentication path and the reset credentials path. An authenticated attacker can exploit this by triggering a race condition during the credential reset process to associate their successful authentication state with another user's session. This can result in the attacker gaining full access to the victim's account and changing their password.

The Cargo Shipping Location for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 6.0 does not properly restrict access to a REST API endpoint that updates order shipment statuses, relying on an attacker-controllable value for authorization, allowing unauthenticated users to manipulate order statuses and shipment metadata.

The FraudLabs Pro SMS Verification WordPress plugin through 1.12.1 does not enforce its SMS-retry limit on the server side, allowing unauthenticated users to send an unlimited number of verification SMS messages to attacker-chosen phone numbers, exhausting the site owner's paid SMS credits and spamming arbitrary third parties.

The agent_memory module accepts a caller-supplied tenant parameter in create_client(tenant=...). Prior to version 0.50.0, the tenant parameter was not validated before being used to construct filesystem paths for secret resolution. A value containing path traversal sequences (for example, attacker-corp/../victim-corp) could cause the resolved path to escape the intended directory and access another tenant's secrets under:Plain Text/etc/secrets/appfnd/hana-agent-memory/<tenant>/Successful exploitation could allow unauthorized access to another tenant's mounted credentials, including OAuth client IDs and client secrets. This vulnerability could enable cross-tenant access to sensitive credentials.

A flaw was found in OpenShift Pipelines-as-Code (PAC). PAC does not verify whether the creator of a Repository custom resource has permission to create PipelineRuns. A namespace user with only Repository and Secret create/delete permissions can cause PAC to execute attacker-controlled PipelineRuns as the auto-provisioned pipeline ServiceAccount, which carries ClusterRole/edit by default. This results in namespace-scoped privilege escalation, enabling Secret read, resource creation/modification/deletion, and potential supply chain injection in CI/CD namespaces.

SAP Cloud SDK for AI (Node.js) could inadvertently include sensitive authentication credentials in error messages generated by certain internal operations under specific failure conditions. An attacker with low privileges and access to application logs or forwarded error output could obtain these credentials, but only after waiting for a suitable failure event triggered by a higher-privileged user and within the limited lifetime of the token, making exploitation complex. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to reuse the disclosed credentials against the associated SAP service, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability.

Furl versions before 3.16 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via unbounded decompression of HTTP responses.

Furl inflates a response body sent with a gzip, x-gzip or deflate Content-Encoding and appends the output to the response string with no size limit. It does this whether or not the request asked for compression, and no option caps the decompressed size. Responses read with write_file or write_code are streamed rather than held in memory.

A malicious server, or an attacker on a plain HTTP connection, can send a small compressed response that expands to exhaust the client's memory and end the process.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Bookly Bookly bookly-responsive-appointment-booking-tool allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Bookly: from n/a through 27.7.

The ARMember Premium – Membership Plugin, Content Restriction, Member Levels, User Profile & User signup plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Registration Custom Field (Profile Cover) in all versions up to, and including, 7.8.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.
vp: armember premium – membership plugin, content restriction, member levels, user profile & user signup

cves.d: The Everest Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form, Quiz, Survey & Custom Form Builder with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the remove_csv_file_after_email_send function in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.2 This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete files within the wp-content/uploads directory on the server, which can lead to loss of uploaded content. On hardened Apache configurations, deletion of uploads/.htaccess can re-enable PHP execution inside the uploads directory. This attack is only possible when the Save-and-Continue addon is active (EVF_SAVE_AND_CONTINUE_VERSION is defined) and the 'Disable storing entry information' setting is enabled on the target form. Escaping the uploads directory and deleting files in the site root can be possible under rare circumstances.
vp: everest forms – contact form, payment form, quiz, survey & custom form builder with ai

cves.d: The WPML Multilingual CMS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass via Race Condition in versions up to, and including, 4.9.7. This is due to the `process_iframe_request` function's language-per-domain SSO handler generating the cross-domain sign-in token via `wp_create_nonce('wpml_sso')` on the logout landing page, where the browser has already discarded its authentication cookies — so `wp_get_session_token()` returns an empty string and the token collapses to the shared anonymous nonce for the current 12-hour tick rather than a user-bound secret — and then storing it in the `wpml_sso_user_<token>_<sha256('wpml_sso'.$domain)>` transient mapped to the victim's `user_id` with no binding to the specific sign-out action or requesting client. Because an unauthenticated attacker can independently derive the identical token by triggering the logout confirmation flow on `wp-login.php?action=logout`, and because the `is_iframe_request()` gate conditions (the per-domain SSO `started` transient and domain-hash derived from the public constant `SSO_NONCE`) are fully computable within the 60-second `SSO_TIMEOUT` window, an unauthenticated attacker can submit the forged `wpml_sso_token_domain` parameter with a `wpml_user_signed_in` status to a secondary language-domain endpoint before the legitimate `wpml_user_signed_out` iframe fires, causing WordPress authentication cookies to be issued for the victim. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to gain access to accounts of users — including administrators — who are actively in the process of logging out during the race window.

The BulletProof Security WordPress plugin through 7.2 does not sufficiently protect its security log files or prevent sensitive authentication material from being written to them, relying on access controls that are not enforced under all common web-server configurations, allowing unauthenticated attackers to read logged request data on affected deployments.

The All in One Addons For WPBakery Page Builder  (formerly Visual Composer) WordPress plugin through 1.2 does not validate a shortcode attribute before using it to build a file path that is included and executed, which could allow users with the contributor role and above to include and execute arbitrary local PHP files on the server.
vp: all in one addons for wpbakery page builder  (formerly visual composer)

cves.d: The Zion Builder  WordPress plugin through 3.6.17 does not sanitize uploaded SVG files or validate their contents before storing them in a publicly accessible location and serving them from the site's own origin, allowing authenticated users with the Author role or above to upload a crafted SVG containing JavaScript that executes in the browser of anyone who opens the file.

SAP WebClient UI allows an attacker to inject and execute malicious scripts in the context of the application due to the absence of a Content Security Policy (CSP) configuration for certain restrictive directives. This vulnerability has a low impact on the integrity of the application. Confidentiality and availability are not impacted.

It was possible for an authenticated non-admin user to modify certain data objects without having the appropriate permissions, which could be used to tamper with audit log creation in AXIS Camera Station.
A vulnerability related to URL redirection handling during the sign-out flow that could allow a user to be redirected to unintended external content under specific conditions.
A vulnerability that could allow an attacker to compromise a system.
A vulnerability allowing for privileged escalation of the viewer account to gain administrator privileges.
A vulnerability that could allow a viewer account to gain unauthorized access to network attached storage devices on the server.
A vulnerability that could lead to a high privileged authenticated user performing a remote code execution attack.
A vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized access.
A vulnerability to perform a privilege escalation attack on the server as a non-admin user.
A WebSocket request sent to a specific API endpoint allows unauthorized access to a separate API endpoint. This bypasses the intended authentication layer.

The Signed Video Framework contained a out-of-bounds read issue in the Signed Video Framework which could lead the application using this framework to crash. The issue exclusively affects the tools used for the validation of signed content. The AXIS OS device's signed video functionality remains unaffected.
Improper shell quote escaping when processing user-controlled input, potentially allowing command injection, which could lead to privilege escalation.

The VAPIX Edge storage API, enabling the escalation of user privileges by circumventing filesystem isolation, granting unauthorized access to protected system resources. This flaw can only be exploited after authenticating with an admin-privileged service account.

The VAPIX SIP configuration API lacked sufficient input validation, which could potentially lead to privilege
escalation. This flaw can only be exploited after authenticating with an admin-privileged service
account.

The VAPIX API dynamicoverlay.cgi which results in a Denial-of-Service of the overlay functionality. This flaw can only be exploited after authenticating with an operator or admin-privileged service account.

A locally authenticated user can achieve privilege escalation via an insecure configuration that leads to unauthorized code execution. This flaw can only be exploited after authenticating with an admin-privileged service account.

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.29.13, apps/dokploy/server/api/routers/destination.ts interpolates the accessKey, secretAccessKey, region, endpoint, provider, and bucket fields from destination.testConnection into an rclone ls command executed through child_process.exec. The `withPermission("destination", "create")` path permits a low-privileged organization member to reach the mutation, close a quoted argument with a crafted field, and execute arbitrary commands in the root Dokploy container, which has access to the host Docker socket. This issue is fixed in version 0.29.13.

A use-after-free issue was addressed with improved memory management. This issue is fixed in iOS 18.7.12 and iPadOS 18.7.12, iOS 26.7.3 and iPadOS 26.7.3, iOS 27.2.1 and iPadOS 27.2.1, macOS Golden Gate 27.2.1, macOS Sequoia 15.8.3, macOS Tahoe 26.7.3, visionOS 27.2.1, watchOS 26.6.1, watchOS 27.2.1. An attacker in Bluetooth range may be able to corrupt process memory.

Insufficient protection of communications in Progress WS_FTP Server versions prior to 2025.0.5 could allow a network attacker to intercept sensitive information or modify requests when unencrypted connections are used.
IBM Aspera Faspex 5.0.0 through 5.0.19 could allow an authorized user to craft a specific message to bypass user authorization and gain full administrative privileges.

IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to gain unauthorized administrative access to other tenants due to LDAP injection. User-supplied input is not properly neutralized in directory queries, which could change the query and grant access beyond the user's own tenant.
IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to gain elevated privileges due to improper authentication.
IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to gain full administrative control due to the use of hard-coded credentials.

IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to execute unauthorized administrative operations and obtain sensitive information due to improper handling of case sensitivity. Access controls are not applied consistently to all variations of a request, which could allow restricted operations to be reached.
IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 could allow a remote attacker to gain full administrative control due to the use of a cryptographically weak pseudo-random number generator.
IBM Qiskit SDK 1.4.2 through 2.6.2 could allow a local attacker to execute arbitrary code due to deserialization of untrusted data.
IBM Qiskit SDK 2.4.0 through 2.6.1 could allow a local attacker to execute arbitrary code due to an out-of-bounds write caused by improper input validation when accessing a corrupted unitary matrix.
IBM Concert 1.0 through 3.0.1.1 contains components that allow potentially unsafe command execution, which could be exploited to run arbitrary system commands on the host.

IBM Concert 1.0 through 3.0.1.1 allows an attacker can supply crafted input that is incorporated into an operating system command without adequate validation or sanitization. Successful exploitation allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system with the privileges of the affected service.

IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.2 An authenticated flow author could write attacker-controlled file content into any directory writable by the service account, bypassing the platform's local file access isolation safeguard. Via a crafted on-disk index, the attacker could also read the contents of arbitrary files accessible to the service process — including configuration files, secrets, or database files stored under the application's data directory.
A path traversal attack in simulation of actions in the Zypp backend of PackageKit before 1.4.1 could be used by local attackers to gain root privileges.
Privilege escalation in the Reader View component in Firefox for iOS. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox for iOS 160.0.
Privilege escalation in Firefox for iOS. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox for iOS 160.0.

FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. Prior to 1.11.3, sofia_presence_handle_sip_i_message() split the To user of an inbound SIP MESSAGE on a plus sign and treated the left side as a chat protocol selector. Selecting the api chat proto reached switch_api_execute(), allowing a peer whose MESSAGE was accepted to run FreeSWITCH API commands, including operating-system command sinks, with the daemon's privileges. Inbound chat is enabled on the stock internal and external profiles, and any authenticated profile account is sufficient; stock directory users without password material can also remove that barrier in affected configurations. The flaw permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution, and exploitation has been observed in the wild. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.3.

GPUStack is an open-source GPU cluster manager for AI model serving and GPU instance provisioning. Prior to 2.2.0, get_current_user in gpustack/api/auth.py treated a loopback request source as the built-in administrator when force_auth_localhost was false, which was the default. A remote request could appear to originate from 127.0.0.1 because client_ip_getter accepted a same-host reverse proxy peer or a client-supplied X-GPUStack-Real-IP loopback value. The bypass allowed unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml. Exploitation was observed in the wild against a 2.1.1 deployment. This issue is fixed in version 2.2.0.

sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux, when musl libc is used without PAM, lacks a workaround for a password authentication bypass (related to misinterpretation of whether a string is intended to be a password hash). For some configurations of accounts, any password between 256 and 1024 characters succeeds. An example of a platform using musl libc without PAM is Alpine Linux.

Cleartext storage of sensitive information in memory vulnerability in Johnson Controls EasyIO Neo IOManager and Tools Installer allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.

This issue affects EasyIO Neo IOManager and Tools Installer: 1.1.0.0.
vp: easyio neo iomanager and tools installer

cves.d:
Improper neutralization of input used for LLM prompting vulnerability in Johnson Controls EasyIO Neo IO Manager and Tools Installer allows Search Order Hijacking.

This issue affects EasyIO Neo IO Manager and Tools Installer: 1.1.0.0.
vp: easyio neo io manager and tools installer

cves.d: A security vulnerability has been detected in esengine DeepSeek-Reasonix up to 2.52.0. Affected is the function discoverDocs of the file internal/memory/doc.go. The manipulation leads to improper neutralization of input used for llm prompting. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.53.0 is able to address this issue. The identifier of the patch is 4ca33493a673c2788aa8598fbca2b2f47a69e1b8. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

A flaw was found in D-Bus. With a privileged Monitoring client attached (for example dbus-monitor or busctl monitor), an unprivileged local user can cause dbus-daemon to abort if a driver-originated broadcast such as NameOwnerChanged or ActivatableServicesChanged cannot be delivered to a recipient (for example due to a deny rule or an exceeded outgoing message queue). Driver broadcasts still use serial 0; when delivery fails, composing the monitor error reply asserts reply_serial != 0 and aborts the daemon.

A flaw was found in GStreamer gst-plugins-good (avidemux). In the superindex and subindex parsers, integer overflow can bypass bounds checks and cause out-of-bounds reads. Because avidemux is auto-plugged by playbin, decodebin, and gst-discoverer, opening or previewing a crafted AVI is sufficient to trigger the issue. Fixed upstream in gst-plugins-good 1.28.6 (GStreamer-SA-2026-0072).

A flaw was found in the token exchange mechanism of Keycloak. When using Standard Token Exchange V2, the system issues new tokens with a fresh lifetime based on the requester clients configuration instead of limiting it to the original tokens expiration. This issue allows an authenticated requester to indefinitely extend access for service accounts by repeatedly exchanging tokens, even if the original client has been disabled by an administrator.

A flaw was found in the OIDC logout endpoint of the keycloak-services component, which handles user session termination in Red Hat Build of Keycloak. The issue occurs because the system sets a session cookie based on an unvalidated token hint before completing security checks. An attacker can use this flaw to fix a session ID in a victim's browser, allowing them to hijack the victim's subsequent login and gain full control over their account.

FairEmail is a fully featured, open source, privacy-friendly email app for Android. Prior to 1.2325, shared attachment handling does not adequately sanitize an attacker-controlled filename before constructing its destination path. A local attacker-controlled app can therefore supply path components that escape the intended shared attachment directory and overwrite or corrupt files in the FairEmail private data directory, including account or message databases. Exploitation requires app lock using PIN or biometric authentication and user interaction to unlock FairEmail. This issue is fixed in version 1.2325.

FastNetMon is a high-performance DDoS detector and sensor. In version 1.2.9 and earlier, the NetFlow v9 collector calls  strlen()  on an attacker-controlled interface-description field without bounding the scan to the field’s declared length. Although fields longer than 128 bytes are excluded from this operation, an accepted field without a null terminator can cause reads beyond the field and packet buffer. An unauthenticated remote attacker who can send crafted UDP packets to the collector can trigger an out-of-bounds read and potentially crash the process, causing denial of service. No fixed release is available as of this review.

Kubeflow Pipelines enables users to build and deploy portable, scalable machine learning workflows. Prior to 2.18.0, the legacy V1/raw-Argo execution cache mutating webhook and cache-server storage path hash selected template fields without the Kubernetes namespace, use the key alone for lookups and duplicate checks, and trust the mutable pipelines.kubeflow.org/execution_cache_key annotation when publishing outputs. In multi-user deployments where tenant namespaces share the cache service, a tenant with workload-submission privileges can read another namespace's cached outputs or seed matching outputs that are substituted into a later step. Standard KFP V2 component pods bypass this cache, matching requires the selected template fields and staleness policy, and arbitrary code execution or service availability impact is not established. This issue is fixed in version 2.18.0.

Kubeflow Pipelines enables users to build and deploy portable, scalable machine learning workflows. Prior to 2.18.0, the frontend GET /artifacts/get route accepts source=http or source=https with caller-controlled bucket and key values, and isAllowedResourceName permits an all-digit decimal host that the URL parser converts to an IPv4 address. The default ALLOWED_ARTIFACT_DOMAIN_REGEX and authorization-disabled standalone configuration allow an unauthenticated caller to fetch internal HTTP resources and receive their response body. In the authenticated multi-user configuration, the same destination-validation defect is reachable by a low-privilege tenant with a valid identity and authorized namespace. Cloud credential disclosure depends on reachable metadata services and attached roles, and the issue does not establish IMDSv2 bypass or credential access when metadata is blocked. This issue is fixed in version 2.18.0.

The Extend B2B - Companies and Users Management for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.4 via the register_company_api. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract sensitive company data including owner and member WordPress user IDs, company billing email addresses, credit balances and full credit histories with admin user IDs, per-member purchase limits and spend totals, and shared-cart records containing purchase-order numbers.
vp: extend b2b - companies and users management for woocommerce

cves.d: Kubeflow Pipelines enables users to build and deploy portable, scalable machine learning workflows. Prior to 2.17.0, the API server's pipeline and pipeline-version creation paths fetch a caller-supplied pipelineURL without restricting the destination. An authenticated caller with permission to create a pipeline or pipeline version can make requests from the API server to internal services and observe a limited status-code oracle. Arbitrary response-body disclosure, credential theft, and integrity or availability impact are not established. This issue is fixed in version 2.17.0.

filelock is a platform-independent file lock for Python. From 3.22.0 until 4.2.1, soft lock classes on Windows read an existing marker with _read_lock_file and remove a stale marker through break_lock_file using pathname operations that wait for an oplock break. Another local account with read access to an unheld marker can keep a Level 1 or batch oplock unanswered, causing SoftFileLock.acquire and related async or fallback locks to wait beyond timeout, blocking=False, and cancel_check. A stale marker under the oplock cannot be broken, but mutual exclusion remains intact and no file other than the marker is accessed. This issue is fixed in version 4.2.1.

Dolibarr is an open-source enterprise resource planning and customer relationship management application. Prior to 22.0.5 and 23.0.1, there is a SQL injection vulnerability in the Third Party company update functionality. The application concatenates the  localtax1_value  and  localtax2_value  properties into an SQL UPDATE statement without numeric conversion or other appropriate sanitization. An authenticated user with Third Party create or edit permission can submit crafted  lt1  or  lt2  POST parameters to read sensitive database information, including password hashes, API keys, and business data, or modify third-party records. This issue is fixed in versions 22.0.5 and 23.0.2.

A flaw was discovered in the mholt/archiver package. This flaw allows an attacker to create a specially crafted tar file, which, when unpacked, may allow access to restricted files or directories. This issue can allow the creation or overwriting of files with the user's or application's privileges using the library.

The Model Context Protocol TypeScript SDK provides TypeScript client and server implementations of the Model Context Protocol. From 1.6.0 until 1.32.0 in @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, from 2.0.0 until 2.3.0 in @modelcontextprotocol/server, from 2.0.0 until 2.0.2 in @modelcontextprotocol/express, and from 2.0.0 until 2.3.1 in @modelcontextprotocol/server-legacy, server-side bearer authentication could accept a valid access token issued for a different service because the SDK did not enforce the token audience. The affected surface is server-side HTTP bearer authentication. The trigger is a valid token whose audience names another service. The authorization server must issue tokens for multiple services, and the application's verifyAccessToken() must not independently validate aud. Applications already validating aud inside verifyAccessToken() are not affected. An attacker with a token for another service could authenticate to the MCP server and obtain the confidentiality and integrity capabilities granted to an authenticated caller. Upgrading alone leaves the new audience validation disabled. Operators must enable audience validation and provide the token audience together. Enabling only the expected audience check causes every request to receive HTTP 401. This issue is fixed in @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.0, @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.3.0, @modelcontextprotocol/express 2.0.2, and @modelcontextprotocol/server-legacy 2.3.1.

Remark42 is a self-hosted comment engine for blogs, articles, or any other place where readers can add comments. From 1.0.0 until 1.16.2, Remark42 globally trusts True-Client-IP, X-Real-IP, and X-Forwarded-For without verifying that the direct peer is a trusted proxy, and middleware.RealIP overwrites r.RemoteAddr before per-IP controls run. In a directly reachable deployment, or a proxy that forwards attacker-controlled headers, a remote attacker can rotate spoofed forwarding headers to obtain fresh token buckets for rate-limited endpoints, bypass vote de-duplication when --votes-ip is enabled, mint anonymous identities, and poison stored comment IPs and request logs. The global concurrent-request throttle and per-request timeouts still limit availability impact. Mitigation support is available in version 1.16.2, but operators must configure --trusted-proxy for the deployment topology.

A flaw was found in the github.com/containers/image library. This flaw allows attackers to trigger unexpected authenticated registry accesses on behalf of a victim user, causing resource exhaustion, local path traversal, and other attacks.
vp: red hat advanced cluster management for kubernetes 2
red hat migration toolkit for containers 1.8
red hat openshift container platform assisted installer 1

cves.d: Altair is a GraphQL client for all platforms. From 7.2.4 until 8.5.8, packages/altair-iframe-sandbox/src/main.ts reads plugin_sandbox_opts from the iframe-sandbox query string and passes attacker-controlled scriptUrls to injectScript() in packages/altair-core/src/utils/inject.ts, which creates script elements in the page. The intended parent iframe flow places the page in an iframe with sandbox allow-scripts and without allow-same-origin, but direct navigation to a crafted iframe-sandbox URL omits that isolation and executes the supplied script in the origin serving Altair. Exploitation requires a victim to open the crafted URL, and the resulting script can access script-readable storage and make same-origin requests according to the deployment's authentication and cookie controls. This issue is fixed in version 8.5.8.

A flaw was found in rsync which could be triggered when rsync compares file checksums. This flaw allows an attacker to manipulate the checksum length (s2length) to cause a comparison between a checksum and uninitialized memory and leak one byte of uninitialized stack data at a time.

red hat enterprise linux 9.4 extended update support
red hat enterprise linux 9.2 extended update support

red hat enterprise linux 8.2 advanced update support
red hat enterprise linux 8.4 update services for sap solutions
red hat enterprise linux 8.4 advanced mission critical update support

A vulnerability was found in Michael-A-Kuykendall Shimmy up to 2.6.4. The affected element is an unknown function of the file src/server.rs of the component Inference API. Versa has confirmed a buffer overflow vulnerability in the IPsec implementation on VOS, aka Versa FlexVNF. 
 
 Buffer Overflow Vulnerability Description 
 
When a maliciously crafted IKE Auth packet is sent to VOS, the vsmd process crashes, thereby resulting in a Denial of Service. An attacker can create a Denial-of-Service attack on the VOS appliances by crafting a malicious IKE Auth packet and sending it to the WAN interfaces on the VOS. 
 
During the IKE Authentication phase, if the IKE SA negotiation fails, and the size of the Remote ID is larger than the buffer size used to process the Remote ID, it will result in a crash of the vsmd process on the VOS appliance. 
 
What is impacted? 
 
VOS nodes configured with IPsec VPN profiles of type controller-staging-sdwan or remote-access-server using a WAN interface as the IPsec endpoint are vulnerable. (IPsec profiles configured with an overlay interface as the IPsec endpoint are not affected.) This configuration typically applies to all Controllers, Hub Controllers, and SSE Gateways. Additionally, site-to-site VPN profiles configured without a peer IP address, hostname, or FQDN are also vulnerable. 
 
What is not impacted?  
 
The VOS nodes listed above are not vulnerable if they are not accessible from the Internet.

The Node.js web service on VOS (previously Versa FlexVNF) is used for URL-based Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) of the VOS appliance and is not required after provisioning is complete. The /authenticate endpoint of this service passes user-supplied username and password values to child_process.exec() through a sanitizer (escapeRegExp) that removes regular expression metacharacters but not newline characters. An unauthenticated attacker can inject a newline character into the username field to execute arbitrary shell commands as the versa OS service user. No credentials are required; the attacker needs only a CSRF token, which can be obtained from an unauthenticated page load. 

Versa’s security hardening guide for Hubs, Branches, and Controllers recommends disabling the Node.js web service after the initial provisioning of the VOS device. This vulnerability is not exploitable on VOS devices where the Node.js web service has been disabled.

The Node.js web service on VOS (previously Versa FlexVNF) is used for URL-based Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) of the VOS appliance and is not required after provisioning is complete. This service generates session identifiers using UUID version 1 (UUIDv1), which is derived from the system’s date and time and its MAC address. As a result, successive identifiers differ only slightly and can be predicted. An attacker who can predict a user’s session ID could hijack that user’s session. 

Versa’s security hardening guide for Hubs, Branches, and Controllers recommends disabling the Node.js web service after the initial provisioning of the VOS device. This vulnerability is not exploitable on VOS devices where the Node.js web service has been disabled.

The Node.js web service on VOS (previously Versa FlexVNF) is used for URL-based Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) of the VOS appliance and is not required after provisioning is complete. This service authenticates users and administrators to its web interface during initial provisioning using default credentials and HTTP Basic Authentication. An attacker with network access who knows the default credentials could authenticate to the service and perform provisioning actions on the VOS appliance.  

Versa’s security hardening guide for Hubs, Branches, and Controllers recommends disabling the Node.js web service after the initial provisioning of the VOS device. This vulnerability is not exploitable on VOS devices where the Node.js web service has been disabled.

The Node.js web service on VOS (previously Versa FlexVNF) is used for URL-based Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) of the VOS appliance and is not required after provisioning is complete. The /decryptTest endpoint of this service is registered in server.js before the session authentication middleware and creates an authenticated session whenever it receives a token that decrypts successfully. Because the key and initialization vector (IV) used for decryption are hardcoded and identical across all VOS appliances, an unauthenticated attacker with network access can compute a valid token, submit it to /decryptTest, and obtain a fully authenticated session without providing any credentials.  

Versa’s security hardening guide for Hubs, Branches, and Controllers recommends disabling the Node.js web service after the initial provisioning of the VOS device. This vulnerability is not exploitable on VOS devices where the Node.js web service has been disabled.

The Node.js web service on VOS (previously Versa FlexVNF) is used for URL-based Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) of the VOS appliance and is not required after provisioning is complete. The express-session middleware in server.js is configured with a hardcoded secret that is identical across all VOS appliances and is used to sign session cookies. An attacker who obtains a valid session ID from any source can compute the correct HMAC-SHA256 signature and forge a session cookie that the server accepts as legitimate. Because the secret is shared across all VOS appliances, a forged cookie is accepted by any VOS appliance in the deployment. 

Versa’s security hardening guide for Hubs, Branches, and Controllers recommends disabling the Node.js web service after the initial provisioning of the VOS device. This vulnerability is not exploitable on VOS devices where the Node.js web service has been disabled.

A security flaw has been discovered in sunkaifei FlyCMS up to e71738e0cfb7ffd48c2ce74242a2dbb43f84f25a. http.cookiejar.CookieJar deleted a stored cookie when a response carried an
already expired Set-Cookie header for it, using the Domain and Path
attributes from the header without consulting the cookie policy. A server
could therefore delete cookies belonging to other domains from a shared
cookie jar, such as the one used by urllib's HTTPCookieProcessor. The fix
consults the cookie policy before an expired cookie may delete an existing
one, as required by RFC 6265 section 5.3.

Due to a Memory Corruption vulnerability in Application Server ABAP for SAP NetWeaver and ABAP Platform, an unauthenticated attacker could send specially crafted requests to the application. If processed by the application, these requests could trigger a memory corruption condition in the parsing routine, which could cause the affected processes to crash and restart. cves.d:
The GitIdentifiers class in Apache Commons Codec did not reject NUL bytes in tree entry names. Because Git uses a NUL byte to mark the end of each entry name in a tree object, a crafted name could make one tree serialize to the same bytes as a different tree. Two different directory trees could then receive the same Git tree identifier or SWHID.



The impact is limited: common file systems do not allow NUL bytes in file names, so trees built by walking a file system are not affected. Only applications that build trees from names supplied by other sources, such as entries of archive formats that permit NUL bytes in names (e.g. ZIP) or names passed directly to the API, are exposed.



This issue affects Apache Commons Codec: from 1.22.0 before 1.23.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.23.0, which fixes the issue.

Apache Commons Codec's Blake3 class documented the output of its doFinalize methods as depending on any previously finalized bytes, so that consecutive calls would return different output. In fact, doFinalize does not change the hash state: calling it again without supplying more input returns the same bytes. The key-derivation example in the class Javadoc, shipped since 1.16.0, derives two keys with two consecutive doFinalize calls. Code that follows it gets identical keys, so the separation between the derived keys is lost. The same applies to any application that calls doFinalize more than once on one instance and expects new output each time.



This issue affects Apache Commons Codec from 1.16.0 before 1.23.0.



Version 1.23.0 corrects the documentation, but the behavior of doFinalize is unchanged. Upgrading alone does not fix affected code. Users should check their applications for repeated doFinalize calls on the same Blake3 instance and derive multiple keys by requesting the combined length in one call and splitting the output, as the updated Javadoc shows.

Monoceros versions before 0.30 for Perl allow a request declaring a large Content-Length to kill a worker by exhausting memory.

The request body is read in a loop that asks sysread for all of the remaining declared length at once. Perl grows the read buffer to that size before any data arrives, so a length larger than available memory makes the worker exit with an uncatchable out of memory error before the application is called.

A remote attacker can force a worker restart with each request of a few bytes.

ai.summary_en: Today's vulnerability curation reveals a critical threat landscape characterized by widespread remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws that severely compromise enterprise infrastructure, with Microsoft ecosystems representing the primary source of risk. Hundreds of critical flaws target core networking services such as Windows DNS and DHCP, cloud platforms including Azure and SQL Server, and developer tools, utilizing techniques like buffer overflows, authentication bypasses, and command injection to facilitate lateral movement and unauthorized system access. Beyond traditional IT environments, significant weaknesses persist in mobile applications, industrial control systems, and IoT devices, exposing operational technology and collaboration endpoints to exploitation via document delivery, network spoofing, and configuration manipulation.

items.reason_zh: CD-ROM驱动程序中存在非信任指针解引用漏洞，可在前置条件极少的情况下允许远程代码执行，影响存储与媒体处理子系统。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows RRAS poses a critical threat to network routing and remote access services, enabling unauthorized machine access.
items.reason_zh: Windows RRAS中的远程代码执行漏洞对网络路由与远程访问服务构成严重威胁，可导致未经授权的主机访问。

items.reason_en: MSXML use-after-free vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute code over the network, impacting XML parsing and web service interactions across enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: MSXML释放后使用漏洞允许攻击者通过网络远程执行代码，影响企业环境中的XML解析与Web服务交互。

items.reason_en: Double free flaw in Remote Desktop Gateway Service enables remote code execution, threatening secure remote access connections and session integrity.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway Service中存在双重释放缺陷，可导致远程代码执行，威胁安全远程访问连接与会话完整性。

items.reason_en: Network Policy Server use-after-free allows remote code execution, compromising network authentication and policy enforcement mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Network Policy Server释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏网络身份验证与策略执行机制。

items.reason_en: Another critical NPS use-after-free vulnerability enables remote code execution, highlighting systemic risks in network policy processing and AAA services.
items.reason_zh: 另一项关键的NPS释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，凸显了网络策略处理与AAA服务中的系统性风险。

items.reason_en: Windows Error Reporting heap overflow allows local privilege escalation, potentially granting attackers administrative control after initial foothold establishment.
items.reason_zh: Windows Error Reporting堆溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，在攻击者建立初始立足点后，可能授予其管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap overflow in Windows Shell enables unauthorized network RCE, posing a critical threat to endpoint stability and security.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell中CVSS评分为9.8的堆溢出漏洞可导致未经授权的远程代码执行，对终端稳定性与安全性构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 use-after-free in the CCFFilter Driver allows network-based RCE, directly compromising core system drivers and kernel integrity.
items.reason_zh: CCFFilter Driver中CVSS评分为9.8的释放后使用漏洞可导致基于网络的远程代码执行，直接破坏核心系统驱动程序与内核完整性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 integer underflow in Windows PowerShell permits network RCE, severely impacting automated scripting and administrative workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows PowerShell中CVSS评分为9.8的整数下溢漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，严重影响自动化脚本与管理工作流程。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 use-after-free in Windows iSCSI enables network RCE, threatening storage area network connectivity and data accessibility.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI中CVSS评分为9.8的释放后使用漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，威胁存储区域网络连接性与数据可访问性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 code injection in the Encrypting File System (EFS) allows network privilege escalation, bypassing critical data protection mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Encrypting File System (EFS)中CVSS评分为8.8的代码注入漏洞可导致网络权限提升，绕过关键的数据保护机制。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap overflow in the Remote Desktop Client facilitates network RCE, targeting a ubiquitous remote administration tool used across enterprises.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client中CVSS评分为8.8的堆溢出漏洞可促成网络远程代码执行，该漏洞针对企业广泛使用的通用远程管理工具。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 missing authentication in Windows Credential Guard enables local credential spoofing, undermining secure identity isolation features.
items.reason_zh: Windows Credential Guard中CVSS评分为8.8的身份验证缺失漏洞可导致本地凭据伪造，削弱安全的身份隔离功能。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 heap overflow in OpenSSH for Windows allows network RCE, exposing cross-platform secure shell deployments to exploitation.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSH for Windows中CVSS评分为7.5的堆溢出漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，使跨平台安全Shell部署面临被利用的风险。

items.reason_en: Critical heap overflow in the Rich Text Edit Control enables unauthenticated remote code execution, representing a severe endpoint compromise vector.
items.reason_zh: Rich Text Edit Control中存在关键级堆溢出漏洞，可实现无需身份验证的远程代码执行，构成严重的终端入侵途径。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the DNS Server service allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, directly threatening critical name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server服务中存在释放后使用漏洞，允许攻击者远程执行任意代码，直接威胁关键名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: UAF vulnerability in the Windows TCP/IP stack permits remote code execution, impacting core network connectivity and system stability across all Windows hosts.
items.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP stack中存在UAF漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，影响所有Windows主机的核心网络连接与系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation via LSASS exploitation provides attackers with direct access to cached credentials, significantly increasing lateral movement risk in Active Directory environments.
items.reason_zh: 通过利用LSASS漏洞实现本地权限提升，可为攻击者提供对缓存凭据的直接访问权限，显著增加Active Directory环境中的横向移动风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word enables remote code execution via crafted documents, posing a persistent threat to enterprise endpoints and user productivity.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过构造的文档实现远程代码执行，对企业终端与用户生产力构成长期威胁。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Windows Codecs Library allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by processing malicious media files, impacting widespread Windows deployments without requiring user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Windows Codecs Library中存在整数溢出漏洞，允许攻击者通过处理恶意媒体文件远程执行任意代码，且无需用户交互即可影响广泛的Windows部署。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Windows Hyper-V permits local privilege escalation, potentially allowing compromised virtual machines to break isolation and control the underlying host system.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 中的访问控制不当允许本地权限提升，可能导致被攻陷的虚拟机破坏隔离机制并控制底层主机系统。

items.reason_en: JupyterLab Desktop's renderer origin check bypass allows local privilege escalation in managed sessions by exposing internal server APIs to untrusted contexts.
items.reason_zh: JupyterLab Desktop 的渲染器源检查绕过漏洞允许在受管会话中实现本地权限提升，该漏洞通过将内部服务器 API 暴露给不受信任的上下文而引发风险。

items.reason_en: GLib's off-by-one error during key file parsing can trigger out-of-bounds memory access or denial of service across numerous dependent desktop applications.
items.reason_zh: GLib 在解析密钥文件时存在的越界错误可触发越界内存访问或导致服务拒绝，影响众多依赖该库的桌面应用程序。

items.reason_en: ThorVG's JPEG decoder mishandles duplicate component selectors, causing heap corruption when processing malformed vector graphics streams.
items.reason_zh: ThorVG 的 JPEG 解码器在处理重复组件选择器时存在缺陷，处理畸形矢量图形流时会导致堆损坏。

items.reason_en: WatchGuard Endpoint Protection's inter-process communication flaw allows local low-privileged users to inject code into the trusted console process, escalating to SYSTEM privileges. This directly compromises endpoint integrity and enables lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: WatchGuard Endpoint Protection 的进程间通信缺陷允许本地低权限用户向受信任的控制台进程注入代码，从而提升至 SYSTEM 权限。此漏洞直接破坏终端完整性并支持横向移动。

items.reason_en: JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA suffers from a DOM-based XSS vulnerability in its OpenAPI preview error view. Attackers can exploit this to steal developer session tokens or execute malicious scripts within the IDE environment.
items.reason_zh: JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA 的 OpenAPI 预览错误视图存在基于 DOM 的 XSS 漏洞。攻击者可利用该漏洞窃取开发者会话令牌或在 IDE 环境中执行恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: An origin validation error in Zoom Workplace for Windows allows unauthenticated network-based privilege escalation, compromising host security.
items.reason_zh: Windows 版 Zoom Workplace 中存在源验证错误，允许未经身份验证的网络基础权限提升，从而危及主机安全。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in NEC WebSAM WinShare enables remote unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands with SYSTEM privileges.
items.reason_zh: NEC WebSAM WinShare 中的输入验证不当允许远程未认证攻击者以 SYSTEM 权限执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: A buffer overflow in NEC WebSAM WinShare's data receiving process allows remote unauthenticated attackers to achieve SYSTEM-level code execution.
items.reason_zh: NEC WebSAM WinShare 的数据接收过程存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程未认证攻击者实现 SYSTEM 级代码执行。

items.reason_en: Origin validation errors in Zoom Workplace for Windows facilitate unauthenticated privilege escalation via network access, posing significant endpoint risks.
items.reason_zh: Windows 版 Zoom Workplace 的源验证错误可通过网络访问促成未认证的权限提升，对终端构成重大安全风险。

items.reason_en: Argument injection via crafted URLs in iTerm2 enables arbitrary command execution with user privileges, posing a direct threat to macOS workstations.
items.reason_zh: iTerm2 中通过构造 URL 实现的参数注入漏洞允许以用户权限执行任意命令，直接威胁 macOS 工作站的安全。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited buffer overflow in the Brotli decoder allows memory corruption and potential code execution, warranting immediate patching per CISA KEV.
items.reason_zh: Brotli 解码器中存在被主动利用的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致内存损坏及潜在代码执行，根据 CISA KEV 记录需立即修补。

items.reason_en: Permissive input validation in the Pardus NVIDIA installer facilitates privilege escalation during graphics driver deployment on Linux desktops.
items.reason_zh: Pardus NVIDIA 安装程序中的宽松输入验证会在 Linux 桌面部署显卡驱动期间促成权限提升。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in AMDGPU sysfs interface allows local users to corrupt kernel memory when manipulating power tables. Poses a direct privilege escalation risk for workstation and desktop systems.
items.reason_zh: AMDGPU sysfs 接口存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，本地用户操纵电源表时可损坏内核内存。对工作站和桌面系统构成直接的权限提升风险。

items.reason_en: Race condition between module removal and /proc inode instantiation leads to use-after-free, potentially enabling local privilege escalation. Critical for maintaining system integrity on Linux-based desktops.
items.reason_zh: 模块移除与 /proc inode 实例化之间的竞争条件会导致释放后使用漏洞，可能启用本地权限提升。对维持基于 Linux 桌面的系统完整性至关重要。

items.reason_en: Futex requeue-PI race condition triggers use-after-free during thread synchronization, which can destabilize desktop applications and enable local exploits. Requires upstream kernel patching to ensure stable user-space execution.
items.reason_zh: Futex requeue-PI 竞争条件在线程同步期间触发释放后使用漏洞，可能导致桌面应用不稳定并启用本地漏洞利用。需上游内核修补以确保用户态执行的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Allows untrusted users to roll back security updates via PackageKit, enabling privilege escalation to root.
items.reason_zh: 允许不受信任的用户通过 PackageKit 回滚安全更新，从而实现提权至 root。

items.reason_en: Heap out-of-bounds write in the 7-Zip LZX decoder corrupts memory when extracting crafted multi-volume CAB archives.
items.reason_zh: 7-Zip LZX 解码器中的堆越界写入漏洞在提取构造的多卷 CAB 归档文件时会损坏内存。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in the Zypp backend simulation allows local attackers to escalate privileges and gain root access.
items.reason_zh: Zypp 后端模拟中的路径遍历漏洞允许本地攻击者提升权限并获取 root 访问权。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Microsoft Teams for Android allows network-based spoofing attacks, compromising mobile collaboration security.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的代码注入漏洞允许基于网络的欺骗攻击，危及移动协作安全。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Microsoft Teams for Android enables network spoofing attacks, increasing phishing risks on mobile endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 的源验证错误可启用网络欺骗攻击，增加移动终端上的钓鱼风险。

items.reason_en: Android Teams injection vulnerability risks cross-platform data leakage and unauthorized message manipulation.
items.reason_zh: Android Teams 注入漏洞存在跨平台数据泄露和未经授权的消息篡改风险。

items.reason_en: Edge for Android path manipulation exposes sensitive local files to malicious web contexts.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Edge 的路径操纵漏洞会将敏感本地文件暴露给恶意 Web 上下文。

items.reason_en: Office for Android access control flaw enables local application spoofing and credential harvesting.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Office 的访问控制缺陷允许本地应用欺骗和凭据收集。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in a widely used mobile productivity app enables unauthorized privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 一款广泛使用的移动办公应用的认证绕过漏洞可实现未授权的权限提升。

items.reason_en: TOCTOU flaw in the mobile browser can lead to remote code execution via malicious web content.
items.reason_zh: 移动浏览器中的 TOCTOU 缺陷可通过恶意 Web 内容导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Improper UI frame restriction in the Bing iOS app enables network-based clickjacking and interface spoofing, degrading mobile user trust and session safety.
items.reason_zh: Bing iOS 应用中不恰当的 UI 框架限制可启用基于网络的点击劫持和界面欺骗，降低移动端用户信任度与会话安全性。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Microsoft Edge for Android permits unauthorized local information disclosure from restricted application directories.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Edge 中的路径遍历漏洞允许从受限的应用程序目录中泄露本地信息。

items.reason_en: Rendered UI layer restriction bypass in Edge for iOS facilitates man-in-the-middle spoofing attacks against mobile browser traffic.
items.reason_zh: iOS 版 Edge 中渲染 UI 层限制绕过漏洞可促成针对移动浏览器流量的中间人欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Teams for Android enables remote spoofing attacks, compromising mobile collaboration endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的跨站脚本漏洞可启用远程欺骗攻击，危及移动协作终端。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android allows remote code execution over the network. Compromising the mobile client exposes corporate communications and sensitive file storage.
items.reason_zh: Android版Microsoft Teams存在路径遍历漏洞，可导致通过网络远程执行代码。移动客户端被攻破将导致企业通信和敏感文件存储泄露。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Microsoft Authenticator allows unauthorized local privilege escalation, compromising mobile identity management.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Authenticator存在身份验证不当漏洞，可导致未授权的本地权限提升，危及移动身份管理。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution via a use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Edge for iOS exposes mobile users to immediate compromise without requiring interaction.
items.reason_zh: iOS版Microsoft Edge存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，无需用户交互即可立即使移动设备面临被攻陷风险。

items.reason_en: The MatchPoint Android app disables proper TLS certificate validation and allows unencrypted HTTP traffic, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks. This severely compromises the confidentiality and integrity of mobile medical device communications.
items.reason_zh: MatchPoint Android应用禁用了有效的TLS证书验证并允许未加密的HTTP流量，致使中间人攻击成为可能。这严重破坏了移动医疗设备通信的机密性与完整性。

items.reason_en: Intel Wireless Bluetooth drivers contain an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that can be triggered remotely via adjacent wireless access. Successful exploitation leads to kernel-level denial of service on affected mobile and laptop devices.
items.reason_zh: Intel无线蓝牙驱动程序存在越界读取漏洞，可通过邻近无线访问远程触发。成功利用会导致受影响的移动设备和笔记本电脑出现内核级拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in the MatchPoint Android app's push notification handler allows attackers to manipulate Firebase queries and access sensitive application data.
items.reason_zh: MatchPoint Android应用的推送通知处理器存在SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可借此操纵Firebase查询并访问敏感的应用程序数据。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds check in the Unisoc IMS stack triggers an out-of-bounds read, leading to remote denial of service.
items.reason_zh: Unisoc IMS协议栈缺少边界检查会触发越界读取，导致远程拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: GV-Face transmits sensitive user credentials over unencrypted HTTP, exposing mobile authentication data to network interception.
items.reason_zh: GV-Face通过未加密的HTTP传输敏感的用户凭据，使移动认证数据暴露于网络窃听风险之下。

items.reason_en: Azure Stack Edge XSS compromises edge compute management interfaces, risking industrial network segmentation.
items.reason_zh: Azure Stack Edge存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，危及边缘计算管理接口，可能导致工业网络隔离失效。

items.reason_en: PC Manager access control bypass weakens endpoint security enforcement on consumer and light IoT devices.
items.reason_zh: PC Manager存在访问控制绕过漏洞，削弱了消费级和轻量级IoT设备的终端安全策略执行。

items.reason_en: Kinect access control flaw allows unauthorized local privilege escalation on peripheral-connected systems.
items.reason_zh: Kinect存在访问控制缺陷，允许在连接外围设备的系统上发生未授权的本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: HTTP/2 front-end state aliasing in the Zephyr HTTP server leads to memory corruption. Affects embedded web services deployed in resource-constrained IoT devices.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr HTTP服务器中的HTTP/2前端状态别名化会导致内存损坏。影响部署在资源受限IoT设备上的嵌入式Web服务。

items.reason_en: Integer truncation in the Zephyr RFCOMM handler enables malformed frame processing. Compromises Bluetooth classic stack reliability within IoT ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr RFCOMM处理器中的整数截断漏洞会导致畸形帧处理。破坏物联网生态系统中经典蓝牙协议栈的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in Microsoft Bluetooth Driver allows privilege escalation over adjacent networks, significantly impacting IoT peripherals and mobile device security.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft蓝牙驱动程序存在整数下溢漏洞，可跨越邻近网络实现权限提升，严重影响IoT外设及移动设备的安全。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in the OpenBMB Internet of Agents registry allows unauthorized data manipulation, threatening IoT orchestration platforms and connected device management ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: OpenBMB Internet of Agents注册表存在SQL注入漏洞，允许未授权的数据篡改，威胁IoT编排平台及连接设备管理生态系统。

items.reason_en: Arista access points ship with fleet-wide static cryptographic keys, enabling attackers to forge and deploy malicious firmware updates that bypass verification.
items.reason_zh: Arista接入点出厂时预置全网静态加密密钥，致使攻击者可伪造并部署恶意固件更新以绕过验证。

items.reason_en: Tasmota smart home firmware suffers from a Referer-based CSRF bypass that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify device configurations remotely.
items.reason_zh: Tasmota智能家居固件存在基于Referer头的CSRF绕过漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者远程修改设备配置。

items.reason_en: ASUS router firmware permits physical USB insertion to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges due to unsafe directory name handling.
items.reason_zh: 由于目录名处理不安全，ASUS路由器固件允许通过物理插入USB执行具有root权限的任意命令。

items.reason_en: Eclipse Kura's file-upload handler extracts client-supplied ZIP archives using insufficient path validation, allowing directory traversal. Attackers can overwrite critical gateway configuration files or drop malicious payloads.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Kura的文件上传处理器因路径验证不足，在提取客户端提供的ZIP归档文件时会引发目录遍历漏洞。攻击者可覆盖关键网关配置文件或投放恶意载荷。

items.reason_en: INFINITT ULite protects image-share links with low-entropy passwords and lacks rate-limiting mechanisms, enabling rapid brute-force attacks. This exposes sensitive healthcare imaging data to unauthorized remote viewers.
items.reason_zh: INFINITT ULite使用低熵密码保护图像分享链接且缺乏速率限制机制，致使快速暴力破解攻击成为可能。这使敏感的医疗影像数据暴露给未授权的远程查看者。

items.reason_en: Unsafe resourceId handling in Signal K Server allows path traversal, enabling unauthorized access to sensitive files on marine hub devices.
items.reason_zh: Signal K Server中不安全的resourceId处理会导致路径遍历漏洞，使攻击者能够未经授权访问海洋枢纽设备上的敏感文件。

items.reason_en: Eclipse Kura's Identity REST APIs fail to validate permissions, allowing authenticated identities to bypass security controls and modify configurations.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Kura的Identity REST API未能验证权限，允许已认证的身份绕过安全控制并修改配置。

items.reason_en: HTTP/2 stream binding flaws in the Zephyr project's networking stack can disrupt IoT device communications by improperly clearing stream states.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr项目网络协议栈中的HTTP/2流绑定缺陷可通过错误清除流状态来中断IoT设备通信。

items.reason_en: Eclipse Kura lacks size limits when downloading deployment packages, enabling resource exhaustion attacks from malicious or compromised servers.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Kura在下载部署包时缺乏大小限制，易遭受来自恶意或已被攻陷服务器的资源耗尽攻击。

items.reason_en: A race condition in the Linux I2C core during adapter registration can trigger use-after-free flaws, destabilizing embedded sensor networks.
items.reason_zh: Linux I2C核心在适配器注册期间存在竞态条件，可能触发释放后使用漏洞，导致嵌入式传感器网络失稳。

items.reason_en: Using stack memory for SPI DMA reads violates hardware safety requirements, risking memory corruption in IoT device communication stacks.
items.reason_zh: 在SPI DMA读取中使用栈内存违反了硬件安全要求，可能导致IoT设备通信协议栈内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Missing cleanup paths during SPI controller registration failures lead to use-after-free vulnerabilities in constrained IoT hardware interfaces.
