items.reason_zh: DNS Server（CVSS 8.8）中的类型混淆漏洞允许拥有权限的攻击者通过网络执行代码，破坏关键的名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in Network Policy Server (CVSS 9.8) enables unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising network access control policies.
items.reason_zh: Network Policy Server（CVSS 9.8）中的整数下溢漏洞可启用未经身份验证的远程代码执行，破坏网络访问控制策略。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in SSTP (CVSS 8.1) permits remote code execution over the network, endangering secure VPN tunnel implementations.
items.reason_zh: SSTP（CVSS 8.1）中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码执行，危及安全 VPN 隧道的实现。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in NPS (CVSS 7.5) allows adjacent network attackers to execute arbitrary code, weakening enterprise authentication infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: NPS（CVSS 7.5）中的释放后使用漏洞允许同网段攻击者执行任意代码，削弱企业身份验证基础设施。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 type confusion in the DNS Server permits network RCE, directly compromising fundamental name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 的 DNS Server 类型混淆漏洞允许网络远程代码执行，直接破坏基础名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 race condition in the Windows DHCP Server enables network RCE, disrupting IP address management and service availability.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1 的 Windows DHCP Server 竞态条件漏洞可启用网络远程代码执行，破坏 IP 地址管理与服务可用性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 out-of-bounds read in the DNS Server triggers network denial of service, degrading name resolution reliability for connected clients.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5 的 DNS Server 越界读取漏洞会触发网络拒绝服务，降低连接客户端的名称解析可靠性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 out-of-bounds read in the Network Policy Server causes network DoS, weakening network access control enforcement capabilities.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5 的 Network Policy Server 越界读取漏洞会导致网络 DoS，削弱网络访问控制的执行能力。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in the TOTOLINK router CGI handler allows remote code execution, compromising home/office networking infrastructure and enabling lateral movement within local networks.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK 路由器 CGI 处理器中的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，破坏家庭/办公网络基础设施，并支持在局域网内进行横向移动。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer/FortiManager allows authenticated attackers to read restricted files, exposing sensitive logs and configuration data across managed security appliances.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiAnalyzer/FortiManager 中的路径遍历漏洞允许经过身份验证的攻击者读取受限文件，导致跨托管安全设备的敏感日志与配置数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Intelbras managed switch contains a remotely exploitable authentication bypass that grants full administrative control over the network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Intelbras 管理型交换机存在可远程利用的身份验证绕过漏洞，攻击者可获取对网络基础设施的完全管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Fortinet FortiSIEM path traversal vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the centralized security monitoring appliance.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiSIEM 的路径遍历漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者在集中式安全监控设备上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Arista EOS BGP agent crashes when processing crafted packets, causing widespread routing session loss and severe network instability.
items.reason_zh: Arista EOS 的 BGP 代理在处理构造的数据包时发生崩溃，导致大规模路由会话丢失与严重的网络不稳定。

items.reason_en: Arista EOS BFD implementation fails to properly validate keyed authentication, permitting routing table manipulation by adjacent network attackers.
items.reason_zh: Arista EOS 的 BFD 实现未能正确验证密钥认证，允许同网段攻击者篡改路由表。

items.reason_en: iXsystems TrueNAS SCALE contains an authentication bypass in its HA heartbeat origin check, granting unauthenticated full-administrator API access and root command execution. Same-segment attackers can fully compromise network storage infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: iXsystems TrueNAS SCALE 的 HA 心跳源检查中存在身份验证绕过漏洞，授予未经身份验证的用户完整管理员 API 访问权限及 root 命令执行能力。同网段攻击者可完全接管网络存储基础设施。

items.reason_en: D-Link DIR-878 routers expose a stack-based buffer overflow in the HNAP VLAN settings handler, exploitable remotely via crafted VID arguments. Publicly available exploits enable complete device takeover and network pivoting.
items.reason_zh: D-Link DIR-878 路由器的 HNAP VLAN 设置处理器存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过构造的 VID 参数远程利用。公开可用的漏洞利用工具可实现设备完全接管与网络跳板攻击。

items.reason_en: Hickory DNS contains a DNSSEC validation bypass where the validator checks signatures against the wrong zone's DNSKEY. Attackers can forge authoritative DNS responses, disrupting critical domain resolution services.
items.reason_zh: Hickory DNS 存在 DNSSEC 验证绕过漏洞，验证器会使用错误区域的 DNSKEY 校验签名。攻击者可伪造权威 DNS 响应，破坏关键的域名解析服务。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in OPNsense's Google Cloud DNS validation module allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via unsanitized model fields.
items.reason_zh: OPNsense 的 Google Cloud DNS 验证模块存在 OS 命令注入漏洞，远程攻击者可通过未过滤的模型字段执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in NETGEAR RAX routers allows network-adjacent attackers to tamper with device configurations and steal administrator credentials.
items.reason_zh: NETGEAR RAX 路由器存在缺失身份验证的问题，允许同网段攻击者篡改设备配置并窃取管理员凭据。

items.reason_en: Command injection in ASUS router firmware enables unauthenticated nearby users to trigger credential overwriting and arbitrary code execution chains.
items.reason_zh: ASUS 路由器固件中的命令注入漏洞使未经身份验证的邻近用户能够触发凭据覆盖与任意代码执行链。

items.reason_en: mDNS string cache overflow in Eclipse ThreadX NetX Duo allows local link hosts to write past buffer boundaries, disrupting network discovery services.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse ThreadX NetX Duo 中的 mDNS 字符串缓存溢出漏洞允许本地链路主机进行越界写入，破坏网络发现服务。

items.reason_en: Inadequate certificate host validation in Fortinet firewalls and proxies enables information disclosure and potential man-in-the-middle attacks.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet 防火墙与代理中存在的证书主机验证不足问题可导致信息泄露及潜在的中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: A double-free vulnerability in libssh2's SFTP implementation allows malicious SSH servers to corrupt client heap memory, potentially leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: libssh2 的 SFTP 实现中存在双重释放漏洞，允许恶意 SSH 服务器破坏客户端堆内存，可能导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unsafe address caching in the Linux IPv6 ICMP receiver triggers use-after-free conditions, compromising network stack integrity and routing reliability.
items.reason_zh: Linux IPv6 ICMP 接收器中的不安全地址缓存会触发释放后使用漏洞，破坏网络协议栈完整性与路由可靠性。

items.reason_en: Unsigned integer truncation in the Linux Netfilter SIP helper can cause buffer overflows or misrouting in VoIP gateways and SIP proxy appliances.
items.reason_zh: Linux Netfilter SIP 辅助程序中的无符号整数截断可导致 VoIP 网关和 SIP 代理设备出现缓冲区溢出或路由错误。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited RCE in Palo Alto PAN-OS firewall management interface, allowing authenticated attackers to gain root privileges. Immediate patching is critical due to widespread deployment and confirmed wild exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Palo Alto PAN-OS 防火墙管理接口中存在被主动利用的远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞，允许已认证攻击者获取 root 权限。鉴于其广泛部署且已确认在野外被利用，立即打补丁至关重要。

items.reason_en: Critical DMA API misuse in the stmmac network driver causes kernel panics under TSO workloads, severely impacting network stability. Requires urgent driver updates to prevent service disruption.
items.reason_zh: stmmac 网络驱动程序中关键的 DMA API 误用会在 TSO 负载下引发内核恐慌，严重影响网络稳定性。需紧急更新驱动程序以防止服务中断。

items.reason_en: BPF packet redirection across network namespaces fails to scrub sensitive data, enabling cross-namespace information leakage. Addresses a fundamental security boundary violation in containerized environments.
items.reason_zh: 跨网络命名空间的 BPF 数据包重定向未能清除敏感数据，导致跨命名空间信息泄露。该漏洞触及容器化环境中的基础安全边界违规。

items.reason_en: High EPSS score indicates significant real-world exploitability for a use-after-free flaw in IPv6 neighbor discovery. Attackers can leverage this to crash network nodes or potentially execute code.
items.reason_zh: IPv6 邻居发现机制中的释放后使用（UAF）缺陷具有较高的 EPSS 评分，表明其在现实世界中具有显著的利用价值。攻击者可借此导致网络节点崩溃或潜在地执行代码。

items.reason_en: Zero-copy XDP_TX action triggers a kernel paging request crash in the stmmac driver, disrupting high-performance packet processing pipelines. Needs immediate stabilization to maintain network throughput.
items.reason_zh: 零拷贝 XDP_TX 操作会触发 stmmac 驱动程序中的内核分页请求崩溃，破坏高性能数据包处理流水线。需立即进行稳定化处理以维持网络吞吐量。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary file write via HA failover configuration sync in Zoho DDI Central leads to root code execution.
items.reason_zh: Zoho DDI Central 中通过高可用（HA）故障转移配置同步可实现任意文件写入，从而导致 root 级代码执行。

items.reason_en: Known exploited SIP parsing flaw in FreeSWITCH allows remote attackers to bypass authorization in software-defined telecom stacks.
items.reason_zh: FreeSWITCH 中已知被利用的 SIP 解析缺陷允许远程攻击者在软件定义电信架构中绕过身份验证。

items.reason_en: Widely exploited password authentication bypass in OpenSSH affects Linux servers using musl libc without PAM integration.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSH 中广泛被利用的密码认证绕过漏洞影响未集成 PAM 且使用 musl libc 的 Linux 服务器。

items.reason_en: Siemens SIMATIC manufacturing automation suite contains a vulnerability that could disrupt critical process control operations and compromise system integrity.
items.reason_zh: Siemens SIMATIC 制造自动化套件中存在一处漏洞，可能破坏关键过程控制操作并损害系统完整性。

items.reason_en: BlackBerry QNX Neutrino kernel suffers from a heap-based buffer overflow in the procnto event handler, allowing local attackers to tamper with kernel memory or crash the system. This threatens the stability of safety-critical industrial controllers.
items.reason_zh: BlackBerry QNX Neutrino 内核的 procnto 事件处理器存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许本地攻击者篡改内核内存或导致系统崩溃。这危及安全关键型工业控制器的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Tianocore EDK2 BIOS firmware contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability exploitable by privileged local users. Compromising SMM handler integrity can lead to persistent firmware-level control over manufacturing and automation systems.
items.reason_zh: Tianocore EDK2 BIOS 固件存在越界写入漏洞，可被拥有特权的本地用户利用。破坏 SMM 处理器完整性可能导致对制造和自动化系统的持久化固件级控制。

items.reason_en: Siemens IoT2050 executes unchecked configuration file commands, allowing attackers who manipulate configs to run arbitrary code on industrial edge devices.
items.reason_zh: Siemens IoT2050 执行未经校验的配置文件命令，允许操纵配置的攻击者在工业边缘设备上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Siemens Mendix Studio Pro exposes its HTTP listener to external networks, risking unauthorized access to critical low-code development environments used in IIoT.
items.reason_zh: Siemens Mendix Studio Pro 将其 HTTP 监听器暴露至外部网络，导致用于 IIoT 的关键低代码开发环境面临未授权访问风险。

items.reason_en: Incorrect probe function sequencing in the MPU3050 gyro driver exposes race conditions that can destabilize critical monitoring systems in ICS environments.
items.reason_zh: MPU3050 陀螺仪驱动程序中探测函数调用顺序错误暴露了竞态条件，可能导致 ICS 环境中的关键监控系统失稳。

items.reason_en: Unsynchronized NAND lock/unlock operations risk data corruption in flash storage controllers commonly deployed in industrial PLCs and SCADA systems.
items.reason_zh: NAND 锁/解锁操作不同步会导致闪存存储控制器中的数据损坏风险，此类控制器常见于工业 PLC 和 SCADA 系统中。

items.reason_en: Improper escaping in Siemens ROS# message definitions allows attackers to inject and execute arbitrary code in control programs.
items.reason_zh: Siemens ROS# 消息定义中的转义处理不当允许攻击者在控制程序中注入并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Implicit active content execution in Siemens WinCC tricks operators into running malicious code on SCADA workstations.
items.reason_zh: Siemens WinCC 中的隐式活动对象执行会诱骗操作员在 SCADA 工作站上运行恶意代码。

items.reason_en: Cleartext storage of sensitive information in Johnson Controls EasyIO memory allows retrieval of embedded control system credentials.
items.reason_zh: Johnson Controls EasyIO 内存中以明文形式存储敏感信息，使得攻击者可提取嵌入式控制系统凭据。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, weakening web application security frameworks.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的身份验证缺陷允许通过网络进行未授权的权限提升，削弱了 Web 应用安全框架。

items.reason_en: Authorization flaw in SharePoint enables privilege escalation across web collaboration platforms, potentially exposing sensitive organizational data.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的授权缺陷允许跨 Web 协作平台进行权限提升，可能导致敏感的组织数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Teams facilitates user spoofing and credential harvesting through manipulated web page generation.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可通过操纵网页生成实现用户伪造和凭据窃取。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Visual Studio Code enables attackers to bypass security boundaries and probe internal networks over the network.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞使攻击者能够绕过安全边界并通过网络探测内部网络。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized local code execution, threatening developer environments and third-party extension integrity.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的命令注入漏洞允许未授权的本地代码执行，威胁开发者环境及第三方扩展的完整性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution over the network, exploiting a classic and highly effective web application attack vector.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中对不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞可实现在线远程代码执行，利用了经典且高效的 Web 应用攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized code execution in developer environments, threatening software supply chain integrity and build pipeline security.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞允许在开发者环境中执行未授权代码，威胁软件供应链完整性及构建流水线安全。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted resource allocation in ASP.NET Core enables denial-of-service attacks, disrupting web application availability and degrading service performance under load.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中不受限制的资源分配可导致拒绝服务（DoS）攻击，破坏 Web 应用可用性并在高负载下降低服务性能。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in SharePoint allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, risking full server compromise.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的不安全反序列化漏洞允许已认证攻击者远程执行任意代码，存在服务器全面失陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint enables authorized users to escalate privileges and access internal network resources.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞使授权用户能够提升权限并访问内部网络资源。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in SharePoint facilitates spoofing attacks against authenticated users within web environments.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞助长了针对 Web 环境中已认证用户的欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint allows authorized attackers to inject malicious scripts, leading to session hijacking and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞允许授权攻击者注入恶意脚本，导致会话劫持和数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Race condition in ASP.NET Core enables local privilege escalation within web application frameworks, compromising multi-tenant environments.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的竞态条件漏洞可在Web应用框架内实现本地权限提升，危及多租户环境。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled resource consumption in ASP.NET Core allows remote denial-of-service attacks against hosted web applications.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中不受控的资源消耗可导致针对托管Web应用的远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Microsoft JScript permits remote code execution via malicious web content or embedded scripts.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft JScript中的整数溢出漏洞可通过恶意Web内容或嵌入脚本实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code exposes sensitive information over the network, risking developer environment compromise.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中缺失的授权机制会导致敏感信息在网络中暴露，增加开发者环境被攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization flaw in ASP.NET Core enables unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges remotely, significantly impacting web application security and API gateways running on Windows hosts.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中存在的关键授权缺陷允许未认证攻击者远程提权，严重影响运行于Windows主机上的Web应用安全及API网关。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution. Represents a classic high-impact flaw frequently leveraged in automated web attacks.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中对不可信数据的反序列化漏洞可触发远程代码执行。此类经典高影响缺陷常被用于自动化Web攻击。

items.reason_en: Second deserialization vulnerability in SharePoint with identical high-risk characteristics. Indicates systemic framework weaknesses requiring comprehensive remediation.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中出现的第二处反序列化漏洞具有相同的高风险特征。表明存在系统性框架弱点，需进行全面修复。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint allows sophisticated spoofing attacks. Enables credential harvesting and session hijacking against authenticated web users.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞支持复杂的伪造攻击，可实现针对已认证Web用户的凭证窃取与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: CSRF vulnerability in ASP.NET Core allows unauthorized privilege escalation. Affects modern web development frameworks deployed across thousands of enterprise applications.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的CSRF漏洞可导致未授权的权限提升。该漏洞影响部署于数千个企业应用中的现代Web开发框架。

items.reason_en: Algorithmic complexity flaw in ASP.NET Core enables remote denial of service, impacting web application availability and performance.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的算法复杂度缺陷可导致远程拒绝服务，影响Web应用的可用性与性能。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Dynamics 365 Customer Voice facilitates phishing and account spoofing, undermining trust in enterprise customer engagement tools.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 Customer Voice中的跨站脚本漏洞助长了网络钓鱼与账号伪造行为，损害了企业对客户互动工具的信任。

items.reason_en: XSS in the Live Share Canvas SDK allows privilege escalation in collaborative development environments, risking session hijacking and code injection.
items.reason_zh: Live Share Canvas SDK中的XSS漏洞可在协作开发环境中实现权限提升，带来会话劫持与代码注入风险。

items.reason_en: Exchange Server XSS enables phishing, session hijacking, and malicious macro delivery against mail users.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的XSS漏洞可对邮件用户实施网络钓鱼、会话劫持及恶意宏投递。

items.reason_en: Exchange Server code injection allows remote command execution against critical mail infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的代码注入漏洞可对关键邮件基础设施实现远程命令执行。

items.reason_en: SharePoint authorization bypass permits unauthorized content modification and internal data leakage.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的授权绕过漏洞允许未经授权的内容修改与内部数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Edge origin validation error facilitates cross-origin spoofing and browser-based credential theft.
items.reason_zh: Edge中的源验证错误会助长跨域伪造及基于浏览器的凭证窃取。

items.reason_en: Critical memory safety flaw in the Chromium-based browser enables remote code execution via crafted web pages.
items.reason_zh: 基于Chromium的浏览器中的关键内存安全缺陷可通过构造的网页实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Arithmetic error in browser engine processing can be leveraged for sandbox escape and remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 浏览器引擎处理过程中的算术错误可被利用以实现沙箱逃逸和远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in browser components allows attackers to execute arbitrary code through malicious payloads.
items.reason_zh: 浏览器组件中的不安全反序列化漏洞允许攻击者通过恶意载荷执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Microsoft Office SharePoint is actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), allowing network-based security feature bypasses that can lead to unauthorized content manipulation or data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的弱身份验证机制已在野外遭活跃利用（列入CISA KEV），可导致基于网络的防御功能绕过，进而引发未经授权的内容篡改或数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting flaw in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables authorized attackers to perform spoofing over a network, potentially facilitating phishing campaigns or session hijacking within enterprise web portals.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞使授权攻击者能够通过网络实施伪造，可能助长企业Web门户内的网络钓鱼活动或会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Federation Services enables network denial of service, disrupting web-based single sign-on and identity federation.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致网络拒绝服务，破坏基于Web的单点登录与身份联合功能。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited deserialization flaw in SharePoint enables unrestricted network code execution, demanding immediate patching due to confirmed real-world abuse.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中遭活跃利用的反序列化漏洞可实现无限制的远程代码执行，鉴于已确认的现实世界滥用情况，亟需立即打补丁修复。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution via use-after-free in Chromium-based Edge poses significant web browsing exploitation risks through malicious site rendering.
items.reason_zh: 基于Chromium的Edge中的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，通过恶意站点渲染带来显著的Web浏览利用风险。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Edge allows attackers to circumvent security boundaries over the network, facilitating drive-by downloads and session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: Edge中的授权绕过漏洞允许攻击者通过网络突破安全边界，促成旁路下载与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Power BI enables network-based account spoofing and session hijacking, targeting business intelligence dashboards and corporate data.
items.reason_zh: Power BI中的跨站脚本漏洞可实现基于网络的账号伪造与会话劫持，直接威胁商业智能仪表板与企业数据。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in HTTP.sys allows network-based denial-of-service, impacting Windows web server, reverse proxy, and load balancer reliability.
items.reason_zh: HTTP.sys中的资源耗尽漏洞可导致基于网络的拒绝服务攻击，影响Windows Web服务器、反向代理及负载均衡器的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in React server-dom packages targets modern frontend build pipelines. Exploits affect server-side rendering and static generation workflows.
items.reason_zh: React server-dom包中存在的未认证远程代码执行漏洞瞄准现代前端构建流水线。相关漏洞利用会影响服务端渲染与静态生成工作流。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Copilot Chat enables unauthenticated network code execution. Highlights critical risks in integrating AI assistants into web interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Copilot Chat中的命令注入漏洞可实现未认证的远程代码执行。凸显了将AI助手集成至Web界面所带来的关键安全风险。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in ASP.NET Core via assumed-immutable data allows network privilege escalation. Weakens framework-level security guarantees for web applications.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中通过假设不可变数据实现的认证绕过可导致网络权限提升。削弱了 Web 应用的框架级安全保证。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables remote credential spoofing and session hijacking against enterprise web portals.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可针对企业 Web 门户实现远程凭证伪造与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Untrusted data deserialization in SharePoint allows remote code execution, representing a high-impact attack path for web applications.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的不受信任数据反序列化可导致远程代码执行，为 Web 应用提供了一种高影响攻击路径。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in Exchange Server compromises email gateway security, facilitating unauthorized mail access.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中通过捕获重放实现的认证绕过破坏了邮件网关安全性，导致未经授权的邮件访问。

items.reason_en: Deserialization vulnerability in SharePoint enables remote code execution via crafted web requests without authentication.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的反序列化漏洞允许在未认证的情况下通过构造的 Web 请求实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint facilitates internal network reconnaissance and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可辅助进行内网侦察与横向移动。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited code injection in SharePoint allows remote code execution over the network, prioritized by CISA KEV.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中被积极利用的代码注入漏洞允许通过网络实现远程代码执行，已被 CISA KEV 列为优先关注项。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Outlook enables remote code execution through malicious email attachments, targeting end-users directly.
items.reason_zh: Outlook 中的整数溢出漏洞可通过恶意电子邮件附件实现远程代码执行，直接针对终端用户。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Server enables authenticated remote code execution, maintaining its status as a primary target for email infrastructure attacks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许经过身份验证的远程代码执行，使其继续保持成为邮件基础设施攻击的主要目标。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge allows unauthenticated remote code execution, frequently facilitating drive-by downloads and phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行，常被用于驱动下载和钓鱼活动。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code permits unauthenticated remote code execution, exposing developer environments and remote workflows to compromise.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中缺失的授权检查允许未认证的远程代码执行，使开发环境和远程工作流面临被攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in PowerShell Core enables unauthorized internal network reconnaissance and information disclosure via script execution.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell Core 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可通过脚本执行实现未经授权的内网侦察与信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Adobe Experience Manager leads to arbitrary code execution under the current user context. As a widely deployed enterprise CMS, this vulnerability poses a severe risk of complete system takeover.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Experience Manager 中的错误授权可导致在当前用户上下文中执行任意代码。作为广泛部署的企业内容管理系统（CMS），该漏洞存在极高的系统完全接管风险。

items.reason_en: Failure to verify cryptographic signatures for JWTs in AsiaInfo BSS allows unauthenticated attackers to forge tokens and execute privileged actions. This critical bypass compromises telecom billing system integrity.
items.reason_zh: AsiaInfo BSS 中未能验证 JWT 的加密签名，允许未认证的攻击者伪造令牌并执行特权操作。这一关键性绕过破坏了电信计费系统的完整性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in the Azure Portal enables spoofing attacks against cloud administrators. Attackers can leverage reflected XSS to hijack sessions or redirect users to malicious endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Azure Portal 中的跨站脚本漏洞可对云管理员实施欺骗攻击。攻击者可利用反射型 XSS 劫持会话或将用户重定向至恶意端点。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based spoofing attacks, risking credential theft and malicious payload delivery in enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可实现基于网络的欺骗攻击，在企业环境中可能导致凭证窃取和恶意载荷投递。

items.reason_en: Duplicate SharePoint XSS vulnerability maintains consistent spoofing risks across web page generation, highlighting ongoing input validation gaps in collaborative platforms.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 重复出现的 XSS 漏洞在网页生成过程中持续带来一致的欺骗风险，凸显了协作平台输入验证机制的持续缺陷。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 allows remote code execution via flawed numeric type conversion in JScript, frequently leveraged in web-based exploit kits and phishing.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1 允许通过 JScript 中缺陷的数字类型转换实现远程代码执行，常被基于 Web 的攻击工具包和钓鱼活动利用。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 enables remote code execution through URL Moniker processing, directly breaching browser and application security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 允许通过 URL Moniker 处理实现远程代码执行，直接突破浏览器与应用的安全边界。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 allows remote code execution via malicious Word documents leveraging HTML rendering flaws, commonly targeted in spear-phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 允许通过利用 HTML 渲染缺陷的恶意 Word 文档实现远程代码执行，常在鱼叉式钓鱼活动中被针对性利用。

items.reason_en: Kong Gateway Enterprise fails to inspect large request bodies, bypassing AI content-safety filters for web traffic.
items.reason_zh: Kong Gateway Enterprise 未能检查大型请求体，导致 Web 流量的 AI 内容安全过滤机制被绕过。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in VS Code allows security feature bypass, impacting developer workflows and web application testing.
items.reason_zh: VS Code 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞允许绕过安全功能，影响开发者工作流与 Web 应用测试。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server allows spoofing. High-severity web flaw directly affects enterprise email delivery and user trust.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞可导致欺骗行为。该高危 Web 漏洞直接影响企业邮件投递与用户信任。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Microsoft Exchange Server allows network RCE. Enables unauthorized file system access and potential remote code execution via web interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的路径遍历漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行。该漏洞允许未经授权访问文件系统，并可能通过 Web 接口实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows privilege escalation over a network. Compromises web application logic and elevates attacker permissions.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许通过网络实现权限提升。该漏洞破坏 Web 应用逻辑并提升攻击者权限。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in Skype for Business allows spoofing. Undermines communication integrity and enables man-in-the-middle attacks.
items.reason_zh: Skype for Business 中不当的加密签名验证机制可导致欺骗行为。该漏洞破坏了通信完整性并支持中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Connect allows privilege escalation without user interaction, enabling attackers to access sensitive resources and administrative functionality.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Connect 中的错误授权缺陷允许无需用户交互即可实现权限提升，使攻击者能够访问敏感资源与管理功能。

items.reason_en: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Adobe Connect can lead to privilege escalation and internal network reconnaissance without requiring user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Connect 中的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞可在无需用户交互的情况下导致权限提升与内网侦察。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability allows attackers to read arbitrary files outside intended directories, potentially exposing sensitive configuration data and credentials.
items.reason_zh: 路径遍历漏洞允许攻击者读取预期目录之外的任意文件，可能导致敏感配置数据与凭证泄露。

items.reason_en: SQL injection flaw enables low-privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code within the context of the current user, risking full backend system compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL 注入缺陷使低权限攻击者能够在当前用户上下文中执行任意代码，存在导致后端系统完全被攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in form fields allows attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in victims' browsers, facilitating session hijacking or credential theft.
items.reason_zh: 表单字段中的存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞允许攻击者注入恶意脚本，在受害者浏览器中执行，从而导致会话劫持或凭证窃取。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Microsoft JScript allows unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising web applications and browser-based script execution environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft JScript 中的堆溢出漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行，危及 Web 应用及基于浏览器的脚本执行环境。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Power Automate enables unauthorized internal network pivoting and privilege escalation within automated business workflows.
items.reason_zh: Power Automate 中的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞可被用于在自动化业务流程中进行未经授权的内部网络横向移动与权限提升。

items.reason_en: Injection vulnerability in Azure Cosmos DB allows privilege escalation over the network, risking data integrity and access control in cloud NoSQL databases.
items.reason_zh: Azure Cosmos DB 中的注入漏洞允许通过网络进行权限提升，威胁云 NoSQL 数据库的数据完整性与访问控制。

items.reason_en: A critical authentication bypass in a widely used WordPress plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to gain administrative control over compromised websites.
items.reason_zh: 广泛使用的 WordPress 插件中存在关键的身份验证绕过漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者获取受感染网站的管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Rails Active Storage via ImageMagick processing enables unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files and fully compromise web servers.
items.reason_zh: 通过 ImageMagick 处理在 Rails Active Storage 中存在的远程代码执行漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者写入任意文件并彻底入侵 Web 服务器。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in N-able N-central allows attackers to probe internal networks and exfiltrate sensitive data from managed endpoints.
items.reason_zh: N-able N-central 中的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞允许攻击者探测内部网络并从受管终端泄露敏感数据。

items.reason_en: Code injection flaws in ASP.NET Core enable unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary scripts within web application contexts.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的代码注入缺陷允许未认证的攻击者在 Web 应用上下文中执行任意脚本。

items.reason_en: Path equivalence resolution vulnerabilities in WebDAV allow attackers to traverse restricted directories and elevate privileges over HTTP.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中的路径等价解析漏洞允许攻击者遍历受限目录并通过 HTTP 提升权限。

items.reason_en: Observable discrepancies in Active Directory Federation Services leak sensitive identity metadata, aiding targeted social engineering or reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中可观察到的差异会泄露敏感的身份元数据，助长定向的社会工程学攻击或侦察活动。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in ASP.NET Core allows remote code execution, remaining a prevalent threat for web application security and session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可导致远程代码执行，仍是 Web 应用安全与会话劫持的主要威胁。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Microsoft SharePoint enables remote code execution, requiring urgent patching due to its widespread use in enterprise collaboration.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint 中的整数溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，鉴于其在企业协作中的广泛应用，需紧急打补丁修复。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows privilege escalation, enabling attackers to pivot to internal network resources.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞可导致权限提升，使攻击者能够横向移动到内部网络资源。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.4 HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core enables request tampering and cache poisoning attacks against modern web applications and APIs.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中 CVSS 评分为 9.4 的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞可对现代 Web 应用和 API 实施请求篡改与缓存投毒攻击。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.3 cross-site scripting in Exchange Server facilitates account spoofing and phishing campaigns, directly impacting enterprise communication security.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中 CVSS 评分为 9.3 的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可促成账户伪造与钓鱼活动，直接影响企业通信安全。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 incorrect authorization in Exchange Server allows privilege escalation, potentially granting attackers administrative control over mail systems and user data.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的错误授权漏洞可导致权限提升，可能赋予攻击者对邮件系统和用户数据的管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in SharePoint enables unauthenticated network spoofing and credential theft through malicious web content generation.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可通过生成恶意 Web 内容实现未认证的网络欺骗与凭证窃取。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in IIS directly impacts web server availability and enables remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: IIS 中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞直接影响 Web 服务器的可用性，并可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Improper path equivalence resolution in WebDAV enables unauthorized code execution via crafted HTTP requests.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中不当的路径等价解析漏洞可通过构造的 HTTP 请求实现未授权的代码执行。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core bypasses security controls and allows request manipulation.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞可绕过安全控制机制并允许请求篡改。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in SharePoint allows privilege escalation within web content management systems.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中缺失的授权检查可在 Web 内容管理系统中导致权限提升。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint facilitates client-side spoofing and session hijacking attacks.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可促成客户端伪造与会话劫持攻击。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in ASP.NET Core undermines security mechanisms in deployed web applications.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的身份验证绕过漏洞会破坏已部署 Web 应用的安全机制。

items.reason_en: Unthrottled resource allocation in ASP.NET Core leads to denial of service through resource exhaustion.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中缺乏限制的资源分配会导致资源耗尽型拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption in SAP Web Dispatcher (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated remote code execution, directly impacting web application proxy deployments.
items.reason_zh: SAP Web Dispatcher（CVSS 10.0）中的内存损坏漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行，直接影响 Web 应用代理部署。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in WebDAV (CVSS 8.8) enables remote privilege escalation over the network, affecting file synchronization and web publishing services.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV（CVSS 8.8）中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程权限提升，影响文件同步与 Web 发布服务。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution through malicious web content, affecting a major consumer and enterprise browser engine.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意 Web 内容实现远程代码执行，影响主流消费级与企业级浏览器引擎。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in Edge's rendering pipeline facilitates remote code execution, highlighting persistent memory safety risks in Chromium-based architectures.
items.reason_zh: Edge 渲染管线中的类型混淆漏洞可导致远程代码执行，凸显了基于 Chromium 架构中持续存在的内存安全风险。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion vulnerability in ASP.NET Core allows unauthenticated denial-of-service attacks against modern web applications and API endpoints.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的资源耗尽漏洞允许对现代 Web 应用和 API 端点发起未认证的拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。

items.reason_en: Acceptance of empty passwords in OpenObserve’s authentication validator allows unauthenticated access to a cloud-native observability platform, risking full system compromise and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: OpenObserve 的身份验证校验器接受空密码，允许未认证访问云原生可观测性平台，可能导致系统完全沦陷与数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated access to Chartbrew’s BullMQ admin dashboard exposes internal job queues and application state, facilitating operational disruption or sensitive data leakage.
items.reason_zh: 未认证访问 Chartbrew 的 BullMQ 管理面板会暴露内部作业队列与应用状态，从而导致业务中断或敏感数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Apache Juneau microservice framework lacks pathname restrictions, enabling attackers to traverse directories and manipulate arbitrary files on the server.
items.reason_zh: Apache Juneau 微服务框架缺乏路径限制，使攻击者能够进行目录遍历并操纵服务器上的任意文件。

items.reason_en: 2FAuth incorrectly trusts reverse proxy authentication headers, allowing unauthenticated users to bypass multi-factor login requirements and gain account access.
items.reason_zh: 2FAuth 错误信任反向代理认证头，导致未认证用户可绕过多因素认证登录要求并获取账户访问权限。

items.reason_en: WP w3all phpBB integration plugin suffers from SQL injection, exposing backend application data to remote exploitation and data theft.
items.reason_zh: WP w3all phpBB 集成插件存在 SQL 注入漏洞，致使后端应用数据易受远程利用与数据窃取。

items.reason_en: SuperTokens SAML callback handler fails to validate RelayState and InResponseTo fields, facilitating authentication token replay and session hijacking attacks.
items.reason_zh: SuperTokens SAML 回调处理器未能验证 RelayState 和 InResponseTo 字段，从而导致身份验证令牌重放与会话劫持攻击。

items.reason_en: Apache Juneau fails to HTML-encode variable substitutions in page chrome elements, enabling cross-site scripting attacks. Applications relying on this REST framework are vulnerable to session hijacking and credential theft.
items.reason_zh: Apache Juneau 未对页面 chrome 元素中的变量替换执行 HTML 编码，导致跨站脚本攻击。依赖该 REST 框架的应用易遭受会话劫持与凭据窃取。

items.reason_en: JetBrains Datalore allows unauthenticated code execution through published interactive reports, breaking tenant isolation in cloud-based notebook environments. Attackers can run arbitrary scripts without valid credentials.
items.reason_zh: JetBrains Datalore 允许通过已发布的交互式报告执行未认证代码，破坏了云笔记本环境中的多租户隔离机制。攻击者无需有效凭据即可运行任意脚本。

items.reason_en: OpenEMR's RingCentral fax module contains a path traversal vulnerability in the disposeDocument method, permitting authenticated attackers to read and write arbitrary system files. This can lead to credential theft and full application compromise.
items.reason_zh: OpenEMR 的 RingCentral 传真模块在 disposeDocument 方法中存在路径遍历漏洞，允许已认证攻击者读写任意系统文件，进而可能导致凭据窃取及应用程序被完全控制。

items.reason_en: Grafana OSS and Enterprise versions allow any user role, including viewers, to create, publish, and delete dashboard snapshots due to missing authorization controls. This exposes sensitive operational metrics and analytics to unauthorized parties.
items.reason_zh: Grafana OSS 与企业版因缺失授权控制，允许任何用户角色（含查看者）创建、发布和删除仪表板快照，导致敏感操作指标与分析数据向未授权方泄露。

items.reason_en: Default credentials in INDOTALENT WHMS allow unauthenticated attackers to gain full administrator access without any initial exploitation step.
items.reason_zh: INDOTALENT WHMS 存在默认凭据问题，未认证攻击者无需任何初始利用即可获取完整的管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: Server-side template injection in mailcow enables domain administrators to execute arbitrary commands within shared containers via malicious email footers.
items.reason_zh: mailcow 存在服务端模板注入漏洞，域管理员可通过恶意邮件页脚在共享容器内执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: IDOR in the MatchPoint API bypasses authorization checks via manipulated headers, exposing sensitive financial, banking, and personal user data.
items.reason_zh: MatchPoint API 存在不直接对象引用（IDOR）漏洞，攻击者可通过篡改请求标头绕过授权检查，导致敏感财务、金融及个人用户数据泄露。

items.reason_en: A hardcoded static credential in the MatchPoint platform grants unauthenticated attackers direct access to core API services.
items.reason_zh: MatchPoint 平台存在硬编码静态凭据，未认证攻击者可直接访问其核心 API 服务。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in PowerSYSTEM Center allows low-privileged users to access administrative resources, breaking role-based access controls.
items.reason_zh: PowerSYSTEM Center 存在授权逻辑缺陷，允许低权限用户访问管理资源，破坏了基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）机制。

items.reason_en: Insufficient input validation in PowerSYSTEM Center's report designer enables authenticated users to execute unauthorized SQL commands against the backend.
items.reason_zh: PowerSYSTEM Center 报告设计器存在输入验证不足的问题，已认证用户可利用该漏洞对后端执行未授权的 SQL 命令。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in Joomla iCagenda allows attackers to inject malicious JavaScript via event URLs, compromising victim sessions and browser contexts.
items.reason_zh: Joomla iCagenda 存在存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，攻击者可通过事件 URL 注入恶意 JavaScript，从而劫持受害者会话及浏览器上下文。

items.reason_en: Improper URL validation in JetBrains YouTrack allows apps to send unauthorized REST requests without user confirmation, bypassing security prompts.
items.reason_zh: JetBrains YouTrack 存在 URL 验证缺陷，允许应用在未经用户确认的情况下发送未授权的 REST 请求，从而绕过安全提示。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in Foxit Workspace's file share preview executes embedded scripts when victims open shared documents, leading to account takeover.
items.reason_zh: Foxit Workspace 文件共享预览功能存在存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，受害者打开共享文档时将触发嵌入式脚本执行，进而导致账户接管。

items.reason_en: Inefficient YAML parsing in Symfony enables denial-of-service attacks by forcing PHP processes to hang indefinitely on crafted documents.
items.reason_zh: Symfony 的 YAML 解析效率低下，攻击者可利用精心构造的文档使 PHP 进程无限挂起，从而引发拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。

items.reason_en: Case-sensitive regex bypass in Symfony Serializer allows uppercase DATA schemes to evade validation, resulting in arbitrary local file reads.
items.reason_zh: Symfony Serializer 存在大小写敏感的正则表达式绕过漏洞，攻击者可利用大写 DATA 协议方案绕过验证，实现任意本地文件读取。

items.reason_en: HPACK header exhaustion in ninenines cowlib allows unauthenticated peers to crash HTTP/2 endpoints by depleting connection memory.
items.reason_zh: ninenines cowlib 存在 HPACK 头部耗尽漏洞，未认证的对等节点可通过耗尽连接内存导致 HTTP/2 端点崩溃。

items.reason_en: Connection process memory exhaustion in ninenines cowboy impacts HTTP/1.1 stability by failing to throttle long-running request handlers.
items.reason_zh: ninenines cowboy 存在连接进程内存耗尽问题，由于未能对长时间运行的请求处理程序进行限流，影响了 HTTP/1.1 的稳定性。

items.reason_en: SSRF in Foxit Workspace's undocumented API endpoint forces the server to request arbitrary internal or external URLs, leaking sensitive data.
items.reason_zh: Foxit Workspace 未公开的 API 端点存在服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，可导致服务器请求任意内网或外网 URL，进而泄露敏感数据。

items.reason_en: File-upload SSRF in Foxit Workspace allows attackers to induce server requests to internal resources and return their contents to the client.
items.reason_zh: Foxit Workspace 存在基于文件上传的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，攻击者可诱导服务器请求内部资源并将响应内容返回给客户端。

items.reason_en: XXE in Wowza Streaming Engine processes untrusted XML entities, allowing remote attackers to read local files with process privileges.
items.reason_zh: Wowza Streaming Engine 存在 XML 外部实体（XXE）注入漏洞，处理不受信任的 XML 实体时，允许远程攻击者以进程权限读取本地文件。

items.reason_en: Directory traversal in WordPress Ultra Addons enables unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary server files via manipulated mail components.
items.reason_zh: WordPress Ultra Addons 存在目录遍历漏洞，未认证攻击者可通过篡改邮件组件读取服务器上的任意文件。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Nango's orchestrator API permits unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary database queries via crafted task group keys.
items.reason_zh: Nango 的编排器 API 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，未认证攻击者可通过精心构造的任务组密钥执行任意数据库查询。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Aptabase allows forging of sign-in links using publicly known secrets, enabling unauthorized account access.
items.reason_zh: Aptabase 存在身份验证绕过漏洞，攻击者可利用公开已知的密钥伪造登录链接，从而获取未授权的账户访问权限。

items.reason_en: IDOR in Dolibarr expense report payments allows authenticated users to view other users' financial data without proper ownership validation.
items.reason_zh: Dolibarr 费用报销支付模块存在不直接对象引用（IDOR）漏洞，已认证用户可在缺乏所有权验证的情况下查看其他用户的财务数据。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Firekylin exposes administrator-only secrets like TOTP and cloud storage keys to editor-role users.
items.reason_zh: Firekylin 存在授权缺陷，导致仅限管理员访问的敏感信息（如 TOTP 密钥和云存储密钥）向编辑者角色用户泄露。

items.reason_en: Uninitialized variable in ModSecurity's XML processing can lead to crashes or unpredictable behavior when parsing malicious request bodies.
items.reason_zh: ModSecurity 的 XML 处理中存在未初始化变量，解析恶意请求体时可能导致崩溃或不可预测的行为。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in SourceCodester Smart Attendance System bypasses admin creation checks, allowing unauthorized account provisioning.
items.reason_zh: SourceCodester Smart Attendance System 中缺少身份验证，可绕过管理员创建检查，允许未经授权的用户配置账户。

items.reason_en: API key cache poisoning in pyLoad enables unauthorized access by exploiting cached legitimate keys with forged identifiers.
items.reason_zh: pyLoad 中的 API 密钥缓存投毒漏洞可通过利用带有伪造标识符的已缓存合法密钥实现未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation in frab conference management allows crew users to grant themselves organization roles via unchecked nested attributes.
items.reason_zh: frab 会议管理系统中的权限提升漏洞允许工作人员用户通过未检查的嵌套属性为自己授予组织角色。

items.reason_en: Role escalation in Storyden permits users with MANAGE_ROLES to create administrator accounts without proper authorization checks.
items.reason_zh: Storyden 中的角色提升漏洞允许拥有 MANAGE_ROLES 权限的用户在缺乏适当授权检查的情况下创建管理员账户。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted URL fetching in LiveDocs enables SSRF and open redirect attacks by passing client-supplied URLs directly to network clients.
items.reason_zh: LiveDocs 中不受限制的 URL 获取功能通过将客户端提供的 URL 直接传递给网络客户端，导致 SSRF 和开放重定向攻击。

items.reason_en: Reflected cross-site scripting in UpSolution Core allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web interfaces, compromising user sessions and sensitive data.
items.reason_zh: UpSolution Core 中的反射型跨站脚本漏洞允许攻击者将恶意脚本注入 Web 界面，从而破坏用户会话和敏感数据。

items.reason_en: Default-disabled TLS certificate validation in the V programming language standard library enables on-path attackers to intercept and modify encrypted web traffic.
items.reason_zh: V 编程语言标准库中默认禁用的 TLS 证书验证机制使中间人攻击者能够拦截并修改加密的 Web 流量。

items.reason_en: Python's incremental HTML parser is vulnerable to CPU denial-of-service via crafted unterminated markup. Widely affects web scrapers and backend services processing untrusted HTML content.
items.reason_zh: Python 的增量 HTML 解析器易受通过构造的不闭合标记引发的 CPU 拒绝服务攻击影响。广泛影响处理不受信任 HTML 内容的网页抓取工具和后端服务。

items.reason_en: libexpat parser allows triggering massive dynamic memory allocations from small documents, leading to resource exhaustion in web APIs. Essential to mitigate for services relying on XML/HTML parsing.
items.reason_zh: libexpat 解析器允许从小型文档触发大规模动态内存分配，导致 Web API 资源耗尽。依赖 XML/HTML 解析的服务必须优先修复此问题。

items.reason_en: Python SSLContext silently skips hostname verification when server_hostname is omitted despite check_hostname being enabled. Undermines TLS security guarantees for web clients and servers using this configuration.
items.reason_zh: 尽管已启用 check_hostname，Python SSLContext 在省略 server_hostname 时仍会静默跳过主机名验证。破坏了使用该配置的 Web 客户端和服务器的 TLS 安全保证。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in the Bookly WordPress plugin compromises database integrity and exposes sensitive appointment data.
items.reason_zh: Bookly WordPress 插件中的盲注 SQL 注入漏洞破坏了数据库完整性，并泄露了敏感的预约数据。

items.reason_en: Race condition in WPML's SSO handler generates predictable tokens, allowing authentication bypass across multilingual sites.
items.reason_zh: WPML 的单点登录（SSO）处理器中存在竞态条件，会生成可预测的令牌，从而允许在多语言站点间绕过身份验证。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Plesk's Site Import extension redirects privileged sessions, enabling arbitrary code execution as root.
items.reason_zh: Plesk 的网站导入扩展中存在路径遍历漏洞，可重定向特权会话，从而实现以 root 权限执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Critical heap overflow in SQL Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, directly threatening database availability and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的严重堆溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，直接威胁数据库的可用性和机密性。

items.reason_en: SQL injection vulnerability enables authenticated attackers to elevate privileges and manipulate database configurations, risking full data compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL 注入漏洞使已认证的攻击者能够提升权限并操纵数据库配置，存在数据完全泄露的风险。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow permits unauthorized network-based code execution within database services, expanding the attack surface for backend systems.
items.reason_zh: 堆溢出漏洞允许在数据库服务中进行未经授权的基于网络的代码执行，扩大了后端系统的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Microsoft Exchange Server enables remote code execution, directly jeopardizing enterprise communication infrastructure and data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的输入验证不当漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接危及企业通信基础设施和数据机密性。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands, facilitating complete mail server takeover and configuration manipulation.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的代码注入漏洞允许已认证的攻击者执行任意命令，从而导致邮件服务器被完全接管及配置被篡改。

items.reason_en: Exposed dangerous methods in SQL Server permit authorized users to escalate privileges, increasing the likelihood of database compromise and sensitive data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中暴露的危险方法允许授权用户提升权限，增加了数据库被攻破和敏感数据外泄的可能性。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in the SQL Server JDBC Driver allows security feature bypass, jeopardizing database connection integrity.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server JDBC 驱动程序中的密码学签名验证不当漏洞允许绕过安全特性，危及数据库连接完整性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution, directly threatening database engine stability and data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接威胁数据库引擎稳定性和数据机密性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL permits remote code execution via database connectivity layers.
items.reason_zh: SQL 的 WDAC OLE DB 提供程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过数据库连接层进行远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL allows remote code execution, compromising middleware data access mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: SQL 的 WDAC OLE DB 提供程序中的释放后使用（Use-after-free）漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏中间件数据访问机制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution over the network, directly endangering critical database assets, transaction integrity, and sensitive organizational data.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，直接危及关键数据库资产、事务完整性及敏感的组织数据。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, risking full database compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证的攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，存在数据库完全被攻破的风险。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in SQL Server allows network-based privilege escalation, potentially granting administrative access to sensitive data stores.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的非信任指针解引用漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，可能向攻击者授予对敏感数据存储的管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution. Directly compromises database integrity and confidentiality on internet-facing instances.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。直接危及面向互联网的实例的数据库完整性与机密性。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in SQL Server allows information disclosure. Undermines database security controls and exposes sensitive query data.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的捕获重放攻击可实现身份验证绕过，导致信息泄露。破坏了数据库安全控制措施并暴露了敏感的查询数据。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL enables remote code execution. Compromises database connectivity layers and Windows Defender Application Control policies.
items.reason_zh: SQL 的 WDAC OLE DB 提供程序中的堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。破坏了数据库连接层及 Windows Defender Application Control 策略。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution over the network, directly threatening core enterprise data stores.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，直接威胁核心企业数据存储。

items.reason_en: ODBC Driver heap overflow allows remote code execution, exploiting a widely used database connectivity interface to compromise backend systems.
items.reason_zh: ODBC Driver 堆溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，利用广泛使用的数据库连接接口破坏后端系统。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in RPC Runtime enables local privilege escalation, weakening inter-process communication security and facilitating malware persistence.
items.reason_zh: RPC Runtime 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，削弱进程间通信安全性并助长恶意软件持久化。

items.reason_en: .NET authorization flaw allows local privilege escalation in hosted enterprise applications and services.
items.reason_zh: .NET 授权缺陷允许托管的企业应用程序和服务发生本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: ASP.NET Core uncontrolled resource consumption causes targeted denial of service against web backends.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 不受控的资源消耗会导致针对 Web 后端的定向拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: VS Code untrusted extension execution risk compromises developer workstations and CI/CD pipeline security.
items.reason_zh: VS Code 不受信任扩展的执行风险会危及开发人员工作站及 CI/CD 流水线安全。

items.reason_en: Core Windows database engine flaw permits local privilege escalation, affecting applications relying on ESENT storage.
items.reason_zh: Windows 核心数据库引擎缺陷允许本地权限提升，影响依赖 ESENT 存储的应用程序。

items.reason_en: Memory safety issue in the popular runtime framework can trigger denial of service in hosted web applications.
items.reason_zh: 流行运行时框架中的内存安全问题可能触发托管 Web 应用程序的拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: SQL injection vulnerability in Microsoft SQL Server allows authenticated attackers to elevate privileges over a network, risking complete database compromise and unauthorized data access.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许经过身份验证的攻击者通过网络提升权限，可能导致数据库完全被攻破及未授权的数据访问。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in the .NET Framework carries a notably high EPSS score, indicating a strong likelihood of exploitation for local code execution.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞具有显著较高的 EPSS 评分，表明其极可能被利用以进行本地代码执行。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization logic in .NET enables unauthorized users to bypass security features over a network, compromising application-level access controls.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中的错误授权逻辑使未经授权的用户能够通过网络绕过安全功能，破坏应用级访问控制。

items.reason_en: Protection mechanism failure in the .NET Framework allows local code execution, effectively neutralizing built-in security mitigations and exposing applications to arbitrary attacks.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中的保护机制失效允许本地代码执行，实质上抵消了内置的安全缓解措施，使应用程序暴露于任意攻击之下。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in the .NET runtime allows network-based security feature evasion, undermining application integrity and update validation.
items.reason_zh: .NET 运行时中的加密签名验证绕过漏洞允许基于网络的规避安全功能，破坏应用程序完整性及更新验证机制。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server allows unauthenticated network RCE. Classic high-impact flaw targeting enterprise data platforms with direct remote exploitation paths.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行（RCE）。这是针对企业数据平台的经典高影响漏洞，具备直接的远程利用路径。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Server permits network code execution. Poses significant risk to email infrastructure and enterprise collaboration tools.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许网络代码执行。对电子邮件基础设施和企业协作工具构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra allows remote code execution, directly threatening database server integrity.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra 中的参数注入漏洞允许远程代码执行，直接威胁数据库服务器完整性。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Azure SQL Database enables unauthorized network privilege escalation, risking sensitive enterprise data stores.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 中的身份验证不当漏洞允许未经授权的远程权限提升，危及敏感的企业数据存储。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Azure SQL Database allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges, directly jeopardizing database confidentiality and integrity.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许经过身份验证的攻击者提升权限，直接危害数据库的机密性与完整性。

items.reason_en: Uncaught exception handling in .NET permits authenticated local privilege escalation, highlighting runtime security gaps in managed application frameworks.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中未捕获异常的处理漏洞允许经过身份验证的本地权限提升，凸显了托管应用程序框架在运行时的安全缺口。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the .NET Framework enables unauthorized local code execution, affecting legacy applications dependent on older runtime versions.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中的整数溢出漏洞允许未经授权的本地代码执行，影响依赖旧版运行时的遗留应用程序。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Azure Database for PostgreSQL allows privilege escalation by authenticated users. This threatens data confidentiality and integrity in managed database environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure Database for PostgreSQL 中的授权不当漏洞允许已认证用户提升权限。这威胁到托管数据库环境中的数据机密性与完整性。

items.reason_en: Improper restriction of communication channels in Azure SQL Managed Instance enables privilege escalation over the network. Weak endpoint validation exposes critical database services to lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Managed Instance 中对通信通道的限制不当漏洞允许通过网络提升权限。端点验证薄弱使关键数据库服务面临横向移动风险。

items.reason_en: Kong Gateway omits callout headers from cache keys, allowing cached responses intended for one caller to be served to another. This cache poisoning flaw facilitates request smuggling and breaks API security boundaries.

items.reason_en: Inadequate access control in the Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver may facilitate container breakout attacks in isolated environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver 存在访问控制不足问题，可能在隔离环境中助长容器逃逸攻击。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in .NET allows remote code execution, exploiting a dangerous pattern that affects cross-platform applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，利用了一种影响跨平台应用程序的危险模式。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in .NET bypasses security features, undermining trust mechanisms across the entire framework ecosystem.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中加密签名验证不当可绕过安全功能，破坏整个框架生态系统的信任机制。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 incorrect authorization in Active Directory Domain Services allows remote code execution, severely impacting directory trust models and domain-wide security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 存在 CVSS 8.1 评分的不正确授权漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，严重破坏目录信任模型和域级安全边界。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 race condition in Deployment Services enables remote code execution during OS provisioning, risking automated deployment pipelines and infrastructure-as-code workflows.
items.reason_zh: Deployment Services 存在 CVSS 8.1 评分的竞争条件漏洞，可在操作系统配置期间实现远程代码执行，危及自动化部署流水线和基础设施即代码工作流。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Storport Miniport Driver enables unauthenticated network RCE, compromising storage subsystem integrity and system stability.
items.reason_zh: Storport Miniport Driver 存在释放后使用漏洞，可实现未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，破坏存储子系统完整性和系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Imaging Component permits unauthenticated network RCE, frequently exploited via malicious image file parsing.
items.reason_zh: Windows Imaging Component 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，通常通过解析恶意镜像文件进行利用。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in .NET (CVSS 8.8) permits remote code execution, impacting backend application frameworks and microservices.
items.reason_zh: .NET (CVSS 8.8) 中存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，影响后端应用框架和微服务。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in Python (CVSS 7.8) allows local privilege escalation, affecting development environments and scripting workflows.
items.reason_zh: Python (CVSS 7.8) 中存在权限管理不当问题，可导致本地权限提升，影响开发环境和脚本工作流。

items.reason_en: Adobe After Effects stack buffer overflow enables arbitrary code execution upon opening malicious files, requiring user interaction but posing a targeted threat to creative professionals.
items.reason_zh: Adobe After Effects 存在栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，打开恶意文件时可导致任意代码执行。虽需用户交互，但仍对创意专业人士构成定向威胁。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8 out-of-bounds write in Adobe After Effects leads to user-context RCE, posing significant risks to digital media production environments.
items.reason_zh: Adobe After Effects 存在 CVSS 7.8 评分的越界写入漏洞，可导致用户上下文远程代码执行，对数字媒体制作环境构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8 heap overflow in Adobe After Effects enables user-context RCE, highlighting persistent memory safety vulnerabilities in proprietary creative suites.
items.reason_zh: Adobe After Effects 存在 CVSS 7.8 评分的堆溢出漏洞，可导致用户上下文远程代码执行，凸显了专有创意软件套件中持续存在的内存安全漏洞。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8 out-of-bounds write in Adobe After Effects results in user-context RCE, requiring file interaction but still presenting a notable threat vector.
items.reason_zh: Adobe After Effects 存在 CVSS 7.8 评分的越界写入漏洞，可导致用户上下文远程代码执行。虽需文件交互，但仍构成显著的威胁向量。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Visual Studio Code enables unauthorized file system access and potential remote code execution, severely impacting developer workflows and IDE security.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 存在路径遍历漏洞，可导致未经授权的文件系统访问及潜在的远程代码执行，严重破坏开发者工作流和 IDE 安全性。

items.reason_en: Gleam dependency resolver accepts forged Hex package contents, creating a supply chain poisoning vector during project builds and deployments.
items.reason_zh: Gleam 依赖解析器接受伪造的 Hex 包内容，在项目构建和部署期间形成供应链投毒向量。

items.reason_en: Illumio VEN installer misconfigures permissions, allowing local code execution to escalate directly to SYSTEM privileges on Windows hosts.
items.reason_zh: Illumio VEN 安装程序权限配置不当，允许本地代码执行直接在 Windows 主机上提升至 SYSTEM 权限。

items.reason_en: Webmin Samba user management interface suffers from command injection, compromising server administration capabilities through unvalidated configuration flags.
items.reason_zh: Webmin Samba 用户管理界面存在命令注入漏洞，通过未经验证的配置参数破坏服务器管理能力。

items.reason_en: FFmpeg Cook decoder heap buffer overflow allows memory corruption via crafted RealMedia streams, impacting multimedia processing pipelines and potential RCE.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg Cook 解码器存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过构造的 RealMedia 流导致内存损坏，影响多媒体处理流水线并可能导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Git's three-way merge code contains a heap buffer overflow triggered during repository merges controlled by external actors. Attackers can exploit this to crash version control workflows or achieve arbitrary code execution during pull operations.
items.reason_zh: Git 的三路合并代码存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，在外部实体控制的仓库合并过程中触发。攻击者可利用此漏洞使版本控制工作流崩溃，或在拉取操作期间实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: The Gleam compiler improperly validates paths when fetching git dependencies, allowing arbitrary filesystem modifications during package installation. Supply-chain attacks can leverage this to inject malicious code into compiled projects.
items.reason_zh: Gleam 编译器在获取 git 依赖项时未正确验证路径，允许在安装包期间进行任意文件系统修改。供应链攻击者可借此向编译后的项目中注入恶意代码。

items.reason_en: Logseq's Local HTTP API lacks authentication validation for token verification, exposing sensitive note data to remote attackers on the host network. This compromises privacy in desktop-first knowledge management applications.
items.reason_zh: Logseq 的本地 HTTP API 在令牌验证环节缺乏身份认证校验，致使主机网络上的远程攻击者能够获取敏感笔记数据。该漏洞破坏了以桌面端为核心的知识管理应用的隐私保护。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in Ettercap's CCMP decryption triggers a stack buffer overflow, allowing network-adjacent attackers to execute code.
items.reason_zh: Ettercap 的 CCMP 解密过程中存在整数下溢漏洞，可触发栈缓冲区溢出，使网络邻近的攻击者得以执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Ghostscript SAFER bypass via type error recovery enables attackers to misuse privileged operators in crafted PostScript or PDF documents.
items.reason_zh: 利用类型错误恢复机制可绕过 Ghostscript 的 SAFER 安全沙箱，使攻击者能够在精心构造的 PostScript 或 PDF 文档中滥用特权操作符。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds validation in GStreamer's RTCP SDES parser risks out-of-bounds reads when processing malformed media session packets.
items.reason_zh: GStreamer 的 RTCP SDES 解析器缺失边界检查，在处理畸形媒体会话数据包时可能引发越界读取风险。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Intel PCM Ring 3 applications enables unprivileged adversaries to trigger denial-of-service conditions.
items.reason_zh: Intel PCM Ring 3 应用程序中存在越界写入漏洞，可使无特权的攻击者触发拒绝服务（DoS）状态。

items.reason_en: ToCToU race condition in Intel VTune device drivers allows authenticated users to escalate privileges by manipulating timing windows.
items.reason_zh: Intel VTune 设备驱动程序中存在 ToCToU 竞态条件，经身份验证的用户可通过操纵时间窗口实现提权。

items.reason_en: ToCToU race condition in Intel VTune device drivers facilitates unauthenticated privilege escalation through flawed synchronization checks.
items.reason_zh: Intel VTune 设备驱动程序中存在 ToCToU 竞态条件，因同步检查逻辑缺陷，可导致未授权用户实现提权。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Intel VTune device drivers enables privilege escalation by corrupting kernel memory structures.
items.reason_zh: Intel VTune 设备驱动程序中存在越界写入漏洞，可通过破坏内核内存结构实现提权。

items.reason_en: OmniAgent approval bypass incorrectly whitelists find commands, allowing prompt-injected agents to execute arbitrary binaries via -execdir arguments.
items.reason_zh: OmniAgent 的审批绕过机制错误地将 find 命令加入白名单，致使遭受提示注入的代理可通过 -execdir 参数执行任意二进制文件。

items.reason_en: Unbounded decompression chain in urllib3 enables massive memory allocation attacks by decoding excessively nested HTTP responses.
items.reason_zh: urllib3 中存在无限制的解压缩链漏洞，攻击者可通过解码深度嵌套的 HTTP 响应实施大规模内存分配攻击。

items.reason_en: Unlimited compression steps in urllib3 cause severe CPU exhaustion and memory bloat when processing maliciously compressed streams.
items.reason_zh: urllib3 中未限制压缩步骤，在处理恶意构造的压缩数据流时会引发严重的 CPU 耗尽与内存膨胀问题。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in dr_wav cue metadata parsing triggers memory corruption when processing specially crafted WAV files.
items.reason_zh: dr_wav 库在解析 cue 元数据时存在越界写入漏洞，处理精心构造的 WAV 文件时将触发内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Sequoia OpenPGP key flag confusion bypasses back-signature checks, allowing attackers to spoof certificate capabilities and bypass security validations.
items.reason_zh: Sequoia OpenPGP 的密钥标志混淆漏洞可绕过反向签名检查，使攻击者能够伪造证书能力属性并绕过安全验证。

items.reason_en: VVC decoder out-of-bounds write in FFmpeg allows memory corruption via crafted H.266 bitstreams that exceed tile entry point limits.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg 的 VVC 解码器存在越界写入漏洞，处理超出图块入口点限制的精心构造的 H.266 码流时将导致内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Improper isolation of shared operation cache resources in AMD Zen2 CPUs can cause instruction corruption and unpredictable behavior across virtualized and bare-metal workloads.
items.reason_zh: AMD Zen2 CPU 的共享操作缓存资源隔离不当，可能在虚拟化及裸机工作负载中引发指令损坏与不可预知的异常行为。

items.reason_en: Mishandled residual data during extent tree insertion in ext4 can cause infinite loops during file operations, enabling local denial of service on storage volumes.
items.reason_zh: ext4 文件系统在执行范围树（extent tree）插入时若残留数据处理不当，将导致文件操作陷入死循环，进而可在存储卷上触发本地拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: An integer calculation error in BusyBox's FTP resume logic allows malicious servers to trigger buffer overflows or data corruption in lightweight network utilities.
items.reason_zh: BusyBox 的 FTP 断点续传逻辑存在整数计算错误，恶意服务器可利用该漏洞在轻量级网络工具中触发缓冲区溢出或数据损坏。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited concurrent write flaw in Linux AF_ALG crypto sockets causes unpredictable data interleaving and state inconsistency. Mandates immediate mitigation due to confirmed wild exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Linux AF_ALG 加密套接字中存在已被活跃利用的并发写入缺陷，会导致数据交错混乱与状态不一致。鉴于已确认出现野外利用，需立即采取缓解措施。

items.reason_en: NFS daemon fails to clear ACL pointers after release, causing use-after-free that can lead to remote code execution or kernel crashes. Critical for enterprise file sharing infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: NFS 守护进程在释放 ACL 指针后未将其置空，导致释放后使用（Use-After-Free）漏洞，可能引发远程代码执行或内核崩溃。该漏洞对企业文件共享基础设施构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated TLS clients can trigger server-side crashes or code execution via SNI callback context manipulation in Python. Highlights severe risks in high-volume TLS termination services.
items.reason_zh: 未经身份验证的 TLS 客户端可通过操纵 Python 中的 SNI 回调上下文，触发服务端崩溃或代码执行。该漏洞凸显了高并发 TLS 终结服务的严重安全风险。

items.reason_en: Reusing bz2 decompressor objects after errors causes out-of-bounds stack writes with crafted input, enabling memory corruption attacks. Important for applications handling compressed data streams.
items.reason_zh: 在发生错误后重用 bz2 解压器对象，配合精心构造的输入将引发越界栈写入，从而导致内存损坏攻击。该漏洞对处理压缩数据流的应用程序具有重要影响。

items.reason_en: x86 memory management window inadvertently skips TLB flushes during context switches, risking stale cache access and potential information disclosure. Requires microcode or kernel updates to enforce proper cache coherency.
items.reason_zh: x86 架构的内存管理单元在上下文切换时意外跳过 TLB 刷新，可能导致访问陈旧缓存并引发潜在的信息泄露。需通过微码或内核更新修复，以确保正确的缓存一致性。

items.reason_en: Scsi slab-use-after-free bug in the Linux kernel poses significant stability risks and potential exploitation vectors.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核中存在 SCSI slab 释放后使用（Use-After-Free）漏洞，带来显著的系统稳定性风险及潜在的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in IBM Qiskit SDK allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code in quantum computing workflows.
items.reason_zh: IBM Qiskit SDK 在处理不受信任数据的反序列化时存在漏洞，允许本地攻击者在量子计算工作流中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Checksum length manipulation in rsync leaks uninitialized stack memory, potentially exposing sensitive runtime data.
items.reason_zh: rsync 中存在校验和长度操纵漏洞，可导致未初始化的栈内存泄露，进而可能暴露敏感的运行时数据。
